def: Kimdir o'z ishlarining oqibati uchun javob beradi.
ex: Political leaders are accountable to the people they represent.
exuz: Siyosiy rahbarlar o'zlari vakil bo'lgan xalq oldida javobgar.

def: Biror narsani to'xtatish qiyin bo'lsa.
ex: I think this game is very addictive.
exuz: Menimcha, bu o'yin odamni juda berib yuboradi.

def: Odamning xatti-harakatini belgilaydigan reja yoki maqsad.
ex: The man is pushing his questionable agenda on his colleagues.
exuz: Erkak shubhali rejasini hamkasblariga o'tkazmoqchi.

def: Boshqalar ishlata boshlaydigan yangi so'z yoki ibora yaratish.
ex: The coach coined the phrase, "There is no 'I' in team."
exuz: Murabbiy «jamoada „men“ degan so'z yo'q» iborasini o'ylab topdi.

def: Biror narsa bilan yaqin aloqada bo'lish.
ex: Scientists believe that brain size might correlate with intelligence.
exuz: Olimlar miya o'lchami aql bilan bog'liq bo'lishi mumkin deb hisoblaydi.

def: Odamni uzoq vaqt juda xafa qiladigan tibbiy holat.
ex: Ron decided to get help for his depression.
exuz: Ron depressiyasi uchun yordam olishga qaror qildi.

def: Kompyuter texnologiyasiga xos narsa.
ex: Students prefer to take notes on their laptops and other digital devices.
exuz: O'quvchilar yozuvlarni noutbuk va boshqa raqamli qurilmalarda yozishni afzal ko'radi.

def: Biror narsaning muhim yoki qimmatli bo'lishi.
ex: The professor lectured the students on the importance of communication strategies.
exuz: Professor talabalarga muloqot strategiyalarining ahamiyati haqida ma'ruza qildi.

def: Kompyuterga ma'lumot kiritish uchun harflar bor tugmalar.
ex: Paul spilled coffee all over his keyboard.
exuz: Pol klaviaturasiga qahva to'kib yubordi.

def: Do'sti yo'q odam his qiladigan g'amginlik.
ex: Many people join social clubs to escape loneliness.
exuz: Ko'p odam yolg'izlikdan qutulish uchun klublarga a'zo bo'ladi.

def: Ommaga ko'ngil ochish va ma'lumot berish usullari.
ex: Many people like to express their opinions online using social media.
exuz: Ko'p odam fikrini internetda ijtimoiy tarmoqlar orqali bildirishni yoqtiradi.

def: Ko'p odamga g'oya yoki mahsulot haqida aytish imkonini beradigan narsa.
ex: The band uses their music as a platform to express their political beliefs.
exuz: Guruh musiqasini siyosiy e'tiqodlarini bildirish uchun minbar sifatida ishlatadi.

def: Biror narsa bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgandan yomonroq.
ex: The condition of the sidewalk is very poor.
exuz: Yo'lakning holati juda yomon.

def: Muayyan joyda kimdir yoki nimadir borligi.
ex: The researcher discovered the presence of bacteria in the water sample.
exuz: Tadqiqotchi suv namunasida bakteriya borligini aniqladi.

def: Kimnidir yoki nimanidir yoqimsiz narsaga duch keltirish.
ex: The location of the trees will subject them to strong winds from the hurricane.
exuz: Daraxtlarning joylashuvi ularni dovulning kuchli shamoliga duchor qiladi.

def: Biror narsaning to'satdan katta ko'payishi.
ex: All at once, there was a surge of runners at the finish line.
exuz: Birdan marra oldida yuguruvchilar oqimi paydo bo'ldi.

def: Fikrlarni bilish uchun ko'p odamga beriladigan savollar to'plami.
ex: I filled out a survey about my shopping experience at the department store.
exuz: Univermagdagi xarid tajribam haqidagi so'rovnomani to'ldirdim.

def: Kimgadir yoki nimagadir hujum qilishni mo'ljallash.
ex: Scientists are looking for new drugs to target cancer cells.
exuz: Olimlar saraton hujayralarini nishonga oladigan yangi dori qidirmoqda.

def: Vaziyat qanday o'zgarayotganini ko'rsatadigan umumiy yo'nalish.
ex: Lucy likes to think she started this fashion trend.
exuz: Lyusi bu moda tendensiyasini o'zi boshlagan deb o'ylashni yoqtiradi.

def: Kimningdir fikr va his-tuyg'ulari hurmat qilinganini his qildirish.
ex: Winning first prize will validate all of Tony's hard work.
exuz: Birinchi sovrinni yutish Tonining barcha mehnatini oqlaydi.

def: Kimyoviy element.
ex: Carbon is found in coal.
exuz: Uglerod ko'mirda bo'ladi.

def: Bir uglerod va ikki kislorod atomidan iborat gaz.
ex: There is carbon dioxide in the smoke from coal power plants.
exuz: Ko'mir elektr stansiyalari tutunida karbonat angidrid bor.

def: Yer yoki qumning juda mayda quruq zarralari.
ex: Some people wear medical face masks to avoid breathing in fine dust and germs.
exuz: Ba'zi odamlar mayda chang va mikrobni yutmaslik uchun tibbiy niqob taqadi.

def: Gaz, issiqlik, yorug'lik, tovush va hokazoni chiqarish.
ex: This iron emits steam.
exuz: Bu dazmol bug' chiqaradi.

def: Biror narsa bo'lishini mumkin qilish.
ex: Studying hard will enable the girl to get a good job.
exuz: Qattiq o'qish qizga yaxshi ish olishga imkon beradi.

def: Biror narsani mayda bo'laklarga yoki kukunga aylantirish.
ex: We grind wheat to make flour.
exuz: Biz un qilish uchun bug'doyni tortamiz.

def: Yana sog'lom bo'lish.
ex: This ointment will help heal your wounds.
exuz: Bu malham yaralaringiz bitishiga yordam beradi.

def: Biror narsani kattaroq narsaning bir qismi qilish.
ex: More women are being integrated into the military.
exuz: Armiyaga tobora ko'proq ayol qo'shilmoqda.

def: Biror narsa eng ilg'or yoki eng yaxshi.
ex: Teresa is the leading expert on brain surgery for dogs.
exuz: Tereza itlarda miya jarrohligi bo'yicha yetakchi mutaxassis.

def: Avval aytilgan gapga qo'shimcha ma'lumot beradi.
ex: Marianne likes to walk to work to save money; moreover, it is good exercise.
exuz: Marianne pul tejash uchun ishga piyoda boradi; bundan tashqari, bu yaxshi mashq.

def: Biror narsaga qarshi ekanini aytish.
ex: The students object to raising the tuition.
exuz: O'quvchilar o'qish haqining oshirilishiga e'tiroz bildirmoqda.

def: Havo yoki suvni ishlatishga xavfli qiladigan modda.
ex: A pollutant in the water killed this fish.
exuz: Suvdagi ifloslantiruvchi modda bu baliqni o'ldirdi.

def: Juda mayda donalardan iborat quruq modda.
ex: Turmeric is a yellow powder used in cooking.
exuz: Zerdachop — ovqat pishirishda ishlatiladigan sariq kukun.

def: Kimnidir biror ish qilishga undash.
ex: The tight deadline will prompt the employee to work very hard.
exuz: Qisqa muddat xodimni juda qattiq ishlashga undaydi.

def: Biror narsani qabul qilmaslik yoki rozi bo'lmaslik.
ex: I'm afraid the teacher will reject my new idea.
exuz: Ustoz yangi g'oyamni rad etib yuborishidan qo'rqaman.

def: Hammaga ma'lum bo'lgan narsaga ishonmaydigan odam.
ex: Kevin is a skeptic because he never believes anyone or anything.
exuz: Kevin shubhachi, chunki u hech kimga va hech narsaga ishonmaydi.

def: Qattiq, suyuq yoki gaz holatidagi modda turi.
ex: Arsenic is a poisonous substance.
exuz: Mishyak — zaharli modda.

def: Biror narsa ko'p o'zgarsa.
ex: The price of the apartment went up substantially.
exuz: Kvartira narxi sezilarli oshdi.

def: 2000 funt yoki 907,2 kilogrammga teng og'irlik birligi.
ex: This dump truck can carry up to 25 tons.
exuz: Bu samosval 25 tonnagacha yuk ko'tara oladi.

def: Yo'lovchi yoki yukni bir joydan boshqasiga olib borish tizimi.
ex: Cargo ships are used for the transport of manufactured goods.
exuz: Yuk kemalari ishlab chiqarilgan tovarlarni tashish uchun ishlatiladi.

def: O'zingiz rozi bo'lgan siyosiy guruh, mamlakat yoki odamni qo'llab-quvvatlash.
ex: The crowd seemed to align themselves with the protestors.
exuz: Olomon norozilik bildiruvchilar tomonida turganga o'xshardi.

def: Qaror chiqarish va qoidalarni amalga oshirish kuchiga ega odam.
ex: The local police department is the authority whenever large crowds gather.
exuz: Katta olomon yig'ilganda mahalliy politsiya bo'limi vakolatli idora hisoblanadi.

def: Hosil, asbob-uskuna va hayvonlar saqlanadigan katta ferma binosi.
ex: My grandparents keep hay in their red barn.
exuz: Bobo-buvim pichanni qizil omborida saqlaydi.

def: Sizga ishongan odamga sodiq bo'lmaslik.
ex: The four friends would never betray each other's trust.
exuz: To'rt do'st hech qachon bir-birining ishonchiga xiyonat qilmaydi.

def: Xristian dinining muqaddas yozuvlar kitobi.
ex: I read the Bible every night before I go to sleep.
exuz: Men har kecha yotishdan oldin Injil o'qiyman.

def: Rim-katolik cherkoviga aloqador narsa yoki odam.
ex: Rosanne is Catholic, so she goes to church every Sunday.
exuz: Rozanna katolik, shuning uchun har yakshanba cherkovga boradi.

def: Umumiy maqsadga erishish uchun kimdir bilan birga ishlash.
ex: The members of the team agreed to cooperate in order to get the project done.
exuz: Jamoa a'zolari loyihani tugatish uchun hamkorlik qilishga kelishdi.

def: Kimnidir rasman biror joydan ketkazmaslik.
ex: The police had to detain the thief for shoplifting.
exuz: Politsiya o'g'rini do'kon o'g'irligi uchun ushlab turishi kerak edi.

def: Chiqish uchun ishlatiladigan joy.
ex: The green sign shows where the exit is located.
exuz: Yashil belgi chiqish joyi qayerdaligini ko'rsatadi.

def: Alohida ajralib turadigan narsa yoki odam.
ex: Holly is an exceptional student.
exuz: Xolli ajoyib o'quvchi.

def: Xavfdan qutulish uchun tez ketish.
ex: When a predator approaches a deer, the deer will flee.
exuz: Yirtqich bug'uga yaqinlashsa, bug'u qochadi.

def: Qandaydir tarzda bir-biriga bog'langan odamlar yoki tashkilotlar guruhi.
ex: Lesley is part of a volunteer network that plants trees in the city.
exuz: Lesli shaharda daraxt ekadigan ko'ngillilar tarmog'ining a'zosi.

def: Kimnidir juda jahldor yoki larzaga solish.
ex: He was outraged when his proposal was turned down.
exuz: Taklifi rad etilganda u g'azabga keldi.

def: Ruhoniy mas'ul bo'lgan hudud.
ex: Greg's parish has grown over the past year.
exuz: Gregning cherkov okrugi o'tgan yil ichida kengaydi.

def: Odamlar harakatlana oladigan tor joy.
ex: Follow the passage down the stairs.
exuz: Yo'lakdan zinaga qarab boring.

def: Cherkov yoki uning okrugiga mas'ul ruhoniy.
ex: The pastor speaks to the members of the church.
exuz: Pastor cherkov a'zolariga murojaat qiladi.

def: Hudud xavfsiz bo'lishini ta'minlash uchun aylanib yuradigan odamlar yoki mashinalar.
ex: The military patrol is responsible for keeping the area safe.
exuz: Harbiy patrul hududni xavfsiz saqlash uchun mas'ul.

def: Zarar yetkazish uchun qisqa vaqtda biror joyga hujum qilish.
ex: The soldiers are looking for the people who continue to raid the jungle villages.
exuz: Askarlar o'rmon qishloqlariga hujum qilishda davom etayotgan odamlarni qidirmoqda.

def: Poyezdlar yuradigan izlar tizimi.
ex: I prefer traveling by rail because it's more convenient than driving through traffic.
exuz: Men poyezdda yurishni afzal ko'raman, chunki tirbandlikda mashina haydashdan qulayroq.

def: Mashina, poyezd va hokazo o'tadigan yer osti yo'li.
ex: The tunnel will lead you to the next city.
exuz: Tunnel sizni keyingi shaharga olib boradi.

def: Biror narsa sizni xotirjam va xavotirsiz his qildirsa.
ex: Will loves his comfortable new sofa.
exuz: Uill yangi qulay divanini yaxshi ko'radi.

def: O'qitish va o'rganish jarayoni, odatda maktab yoki kollejda.
ex: These students are receiving their education at a private school.
exuz: Bu o'quvchilar ta'limni xususiy maktabda olishmoqda.

def: Odamni qat'iyatli va umidli qiladigan narsa.
ex: The mother gives constant encouragement to her son.
exuz: Ona o'g'liga doimiy rag'bat beradi.

def: Kimdir yoki nimadir uchun rasmiy yordam bildirish.
ex: The committee will endorse their leader for the upcoming election.
exuz: Qo'mita kelgusi saylovda o'z rahbarini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.

def: Hajmi, soni, miqdori yoki qiymati bir xil.
ex: The apple and orange are equal in weight.
exuz: Olma va apelsin vazni teng.

def: Biror narsaga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri duch kelish.
ex: Justin will face many challenges at work.
exuz: Jastin ishda ko'p sinovlarga duch keladi.

def: Odamlar o'rganadigan yoki ishlaydigan soha.
ex: Jane works in the healthcare field.
exuz: Jeyn sog'liqni saqlash sohasida ishlaydi.

def: Ko'nikma, tuyg'u yoki g'oyaning o'sishiga yordam berish.
ex: The afterschool program is designed to foster a sense of community at school.
exuz: Darsdan keyingi dastur maktabda jamoa tuyg'usini rivojlantirishga mo'ljallangan.

def: Ish, ta'lim yoki shaxsiy hayot haqida berilgan yordam va maslahat.
ex: Ms. Smith provided valuable guidance to all her students.
exuz: Smit xonim barcha o'quvchilariga qimmatli yo'l-yo'riq berdi.

def: Muayyan daraja, unvon, rekord yoki ishga ega bo'lish.
ex: Damian will soon hold a degree in business administration.
exuz: Damian tez orada biznes boshqaruvi bo'yicha diplomga ega bo'ladi.

def: Biror kishi yoki narsani kattaroq guruhga kiritish.
ex: The school promotes the inclusion of parents in their students' education.
exuz: Maktab ota-onalarni o'quvchilar ta'limiga jalb qilishni rag'batlantiradi.

def: Kimnidir ishonchli va g'ayratli qilish orqali rag'batlantirish.
ex: Jim's father likes to inspire his son by encouraging him to follow his dream.
exuz: Jimning otasi o'g'lini orzusiga intilishga undab ilhomlantirishni yoqtiradi.

def: Biror narsa yoki kimdir qanchalik kichik yoki ahamiyatsizligini ta'kidlaydi.
ex: Scott lost the race by a mere two seconds.
exuz: Skott poygani atigi ikki soniya farq bilan yutqazdi.

def: Tashkilot yoki kompaniyadagi martaba yoki vazifa.
ex: Kyle is interviewing for a marketing position.
exuz: Kayl marketing lavozimiga suhbatdan o'tmoqda.

def: Odamlarga ta'sir qilish yoki ularda kuchli his uyg'otish qobiliyati.
ex: The coach has the power to keep the players from playing if they don't show up to practice.
exuz: Murabbiy mashg'ulotga kelmagan o'yinchilarni o'ynatmaslik huquqiga ega.

def: Siz bajarishingiz kerak bo'lgan vazifa.
ex: Parents have the responsibility to raise their children with love.
exuz: Ota-onalar farzandlarini mehr bilan tarbiyalash mas'uliyatiga ega.

def: Tez yuqori darajaga ko'tarilish.
ex: The temperature today will soar to a high of 100 degrees Fahrenheit.
exuz: Bugun harorat 100 daraja Farengeytgacha ko'tariladi.

def: Ishingizda foydali bo'ladigan jihoz yoki ko'nikma.
ex: Presentation skills are an important tool for communication.
exuz: Taqdimot qilish ko'nikmalari muloqot uchun muhim vositadir.

def: Odam o'z fikrini ochiq bildirsa.
ex: Shawn gets vocal when someone disagrees with his opinions.
exuz: Kimdir fikriga qo'shilmasa, Shon ochiq-oydin gapiradi.

def: Siz ishlaydigan xona yoki bino.
ex: Diversity is important in the workplace.
exuz: Ish joyida xilma-xillik muhim.

def: Maktab va ta'limga aloqador narsa.
ex: Alex received an award for his academic achievements.
exuz: Aleks akademik yutuqlari uchun mukofot oldi.

def: Odamlar g'oya yoki fikrni to'g'ri deb qabul qilishi.
ex: Mr. Song celebrated his acceptance into the political party.
exuz: Janob Song siyosiy partiyaga qabul qilinganini nishonladi.

def: Katta guruh yoki ko'p miqdordagi narsalar.
ex: The toy cars are available in an array of colors.
exuz: O'yinchoq mashinalar turli ranglarda mavjud.

def: Biror narsani noaniq yoki ko'rish qiyin qilish.
ex: The photographer can blur the bright lights into the background.
exuz: Fotograf yorqin chiroqlarni orqa fonda xiralashtira oladi.

def: Ichimlik va oddiy taom sotib olsa bo'ladigan kichik restoran.
ex: Monica works part-time at a café.
exuz: Monika kafeda yarim kunlik ishlaydi.

def: Rassomlar rasm chizadigan qalin mato.
ex: The artist paints bright colors on a canvas.
exuz: Rassom matoga yorqin ranglar bilan chizadi.

def: Filmlar ko'rsatiladigan bino.
ex: My sister enjoys watching movies at the cinema.
exuz: Singlim kinoteatrda film ko'rishni yoqtiradi.

def: Jamiyatdagi odamlar ijtimoiy-iqtisodiy guruhlarga bo'linishi.
ex: This upper-class family travels on a private jet.
exuz: Bu yuqori tabaqa oilasi xususiy samolyotda sayohat qiladi.

def: Biror narsa o'ziga xos xususiyatga ega va oson tanib olinadi.
ex: Olives have a distinctive flavor.
exuz: Zaytunning o'ziga xos ta'mi bor.

def: Biror narsa juda muhim.
ex: Marco is a key player on the country's national team.
exuz: Marko mamlakat terma jamoasining asosiy o'yinchisi.

def: Odamlar birga ishlaydigan tashkil etilgan tadbirlar seriyasi.
ex: Booker T. Washington was a member of the civil rights movement.
exuz: Bukker T. Vashington fuqarolik huquqlari harakati a'zosi edi.

def: Odam tez-tez yoki muntazam qiladigan ish.
ex: Samuel has made it a practice to read the newspaper every morning.
exuz: Samuel har ertalab gazeta o'qishni odat qilib olgan.

def: Biror narsa haqiqiy hayotdagidek ko'rsatilgan.
ex: Dorothy is painting realistic images of fish.
exuz: Doroti baliqlarning haqiqatga o'xshash tasvirlarini chizmoqda.

def: Ko'zgu yoki yaltiroq sirtda ko'rinadigan tasvir.
ex: The man stared at his reflection in the mirror.
exuz: Erkak ko'zgudagi aksiga tikilib qoldi.

def: Narsalar qanday qilinishi yoki nima mumkinligini bildiradigan rasmiy ko'rsatma.
ex: Wearing a helmet while riding a bicycle is a rule in some cities.
exuz: Velosipedda yurganda shlem kiyish ba'zi shaharlarda qoida hisoblanadi.

def: Yozayotganda yoki rasm chizayotganda qalam yoki cho'tkaning bitta harakati.
ex: The artist began with a yellow stroke on his painting.
exuz: Rassom rasmini sariq chizgi bilan boshladi.

def: Quyoshdan keladigan tabiiy yorug'lik.
ex: The sunlight shines through the trees.
exuz: Quyosh nuri daraxtlar orasidan o'tib porlaydi.

def: Eski fikrlarga asoslangan narsa.
ex: I prefer traditional furniture.
exuz: Men an'anaviy mebelni afzal ko'raman.

def: Muayyan odam yoki narsadan butunlay boshqacha ekanini bildiradi.
ex: Unlike his older brother, Jim is short.
exuz: Katta akasidan farqli o'laroq, Jim past bo'yli.

def: Biror narsaning bir tomonidan ikkinchisigacha bo'lgan masofa.
ex: The man is measuring the width of the box.
exuz: Erkak qutining enini o'lchayapti.

def: Rasmiy yoki diniy qo'shiq.
ex: Everyone sings the national anthem before the baseball game starts.
exuz: Beysbol o'yini boshlanishidan oldin hamma davlat madhiyasini kuylaydi.

def: Bir narsa boshqasidan ortiq ekanini bildiradi.
ex: The job is beyond the man's ability.
exuz: Bu ish erkakning qobiliyatidan tashqarida.

def: Qiyin bo'lsa ham biror ishni qilishga urinayotgan paytda sizda bo'ladigan narsa.
ex: Chris is the youngest competitor, but he has the most determination.
exuz: Kris eng yosh ishtirokchi, lekin eng qat'iyatli.

def: Urush yoki ko'chada odamlar o'rtasidagi jismoniy to'qnashuv.
ex: Heavy fighting continued for days.
exuz: Og'ir janglar bir necha kun davom etdi.

def: Ikki yoki undan ortiq odam birga qiladigan yoki ishtirok etadigan narsa.
ex: Mike and Joanna are joint owners of a coffee shop.
exuz: Mayk va Joanna qahvaxonaning qo'shma egalari.

def: Parvozdan keyin yerga qaytish.
ex: The man is in charge of leading the landing in the warzone.
exuz: Erkak urush hududidagi qo'nishga rahbarlik qilmoqda.

def: Muhim voqea yoki vaqtni biror ish qilib nishonlash.
ex: My grandparents are having a party to mark their 50th anniversary.
exuz: Bobo-buvimlar 50 yillik to'y yilligini nishonlash uchun ziyofat qilmoqda.

def: Qo'shinni urushga tayyorlash.
ex: Thousands of soldiers were ready to mobilize for the fight.
exuz: Minglab askar jangga safarbar bo'lishga tayyor edi.

def: O'z hukumati boshqaradigan katta yer maydoni.
ex: India is a nation that is developing rapidly.
exuz: Hindiston tez rivojlanayotgan davlat.

def: «Boshida» yoki «birinchi bo'lib boshlanganda» ma'nosida ishlatiladi.
ex: This building was originally a bank.
exuz: Bu bino dastlab bank bo'lgan.

def: Jang yoki kasallikning to'satdan boshlanishi yoki ko'payishi.
ex: The scientists prepared for an outbreak of a dangerous virus.
exuz: Olimlar xavfli virusning tarqalishiga tayyorlandi.

def: Yordam so'rash yoki shukr aytish uchun Xudo bilan gaplashish.
ex: The girl likes to pray for world peace.
exuz: Qiz butun dunyo tinchligi uchun duo qilishni yoqtiradi.

def: Kuch bilan olib, biror joyda ushlab turilgan odam.
ex: He has been a prisoner for many years.
exuz: U ko'p yillardan beri mahbus.

def: Boshqa narsaga erishish yoki boshqa odam uchun biror narsadan voz kechish.
ex: Karen has had to sacrifice a lot for her children.
exuz: Karen bolalari uchun ko'p narsadan voz kechishi kerak bo'ldi.

def: Tovush yoki shovqinning butunlay yo'qligi.
ex: I can only sleep in complete silence.
exuz: Men faqat to'liq sukunatda uxlay olaman.

def: «Hozirgina aytilgan narsaning natijasida» ma'nosida ishlatiladi.
ex: Victor wants to lose weight; thus, he'll go on a diet and start exercising.
exuz: Viktor ozmoqchi; shu sababli u parhez qilib, mashq qila boshlaydi.

def: Kimgadir hurmat ko'rsatish uchun aytadigan, qiladigan yoki beradigan narsa.
ex: In some countries, people wear poppies as a tribute to veterans.
exuz: Ba'zi mamlakatlarda odamlar faxriylarga hurmat sifatida lolaqizg'aldoq taqishadi.

def: Jang, o'yin, saylov yoki bahsda yutish holati.
ex: The man was thrilled with his victory.
exuz: Erkak g'alabasidan juda xursand edi.

def: Nazoratsiz bo'lish.
ex: Dandelions grow wild in the cracks of the streets.
exuz: Qoqigullar ko'cha yoriqlarida yovvoyi o'sadi.

def: Teri kesilishi yoki shikastlanishi orqali kimgadir yoki nimagadir zarar yetkazish.
ex: The boy knew he might wound his knees if he didn't wear pads on them.
exuz: Bola tizzalariga himoya taqmasa, ularni yaralab olishi mumkinligini bilardi.

def: Yangi madaniyat odatlarini qabul qilib, uning to'liq bir qismiga aylanish.
ex: When the family moves to the US they will assimilate into American culture.
exuz: Oila AQShga ko'chib o'tganda, ular Amerika madaniyatiga singib ketadi.

def: Biror ishni, ayniqsa qiyin ishni, qilishga harakat.
ex: This is Ben's second attempt to climb Mt. Everest.
exuz: Bu Benning Everestga chiqishdagi ikkinchi urinishi.

def: Muayyan vaziyat yoki biror narsaning sodir bo'lishiga misol.
ex: A deposit of $1,000 is required, but in this case, we will accept half.
exuz: 1000 dollar depozit talab qilinadi, lekin bu holatda yarmini qabul qilamiz.

def: Biror ishni qilishni yoki biror narsa sodir bo'lishini to'xtatish.
ex: The rain will cease in the afternoon.
exuz: Yomg'ir tushdan keyin to'xtaydi.

def: Kimdir yoki nimadir zarar ko'rishi, vayron bo'lishi yoki o'lishi ehtimoli.
ex: Smoking cigarettes is a danger to health.
exuz: Sigareta chekish sog'liq uchun xavfli.

def: Kimgadir yoki nimagadir katta zarar yetkazadigan narsa.
ex: The tsunami had devastating effects on the seaside village.
exuz: Sunami dengiz bo'yidagi qishloqqa vayron qiluvchi ta'sir ko'rsatdi.

def: Turli shakl, tur, g'oyalar va hokazolarning ko'pligi.
ex: My company puts an emphasis on the importance of having cultural diversity.
exuz: Kompaniyam madaniy xilma-xillikning ahamiyatiga e'tibor qaratadi.

def: Yer yuzining bir qismi to'satdan silkinishi, ko'pincha katta zarar yetkazadi.
ex: The earthquake caused the road to crack in multiple places.
exuz: Zilzila yo'lning bir necha joyini yorib yubordi.

def: Biror narsa juda kam bo'lib, butunlay yo'qolib ketishi mumkin.
ex: The whooping crane is an endangered species.
exuz: Qichqiriq turna yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostidagi tur.

def: Muayyan hayvon, o'simlik yoki odat mavjud bo'lishdan to'xtashi.
ex: The extinction of the dodo bird occurred in the 1600s.
exuz: Dodo qushining qirilib ketishi 1600-yillarda sodir bo'lgan.

def: «Kelajakda doim» yoki «juda uzoq vaqt» o'rnida ishlatiladi.
ex: Michelle and Tanya want to be best friends forever.
exuz: Mishel va Tanya abadiy eng yaqin do'st bo'lishni xohlaydi.

def: «Ko'p hollarda» yoki «ko'p odamlar uchun» o'rnida ishlatiladi.
ex: The suburbs are generally viewed as a good place to raise children.
exuz: Shahar atrofi odatda bolalarni tarbiyalash uchun yaxshi joy hisoblanadi.

def: Butun bir guruh yoki irq odamlarini ataylab qirib tashlash.
ex: As a result of the genocide, many children have been orphaned.
exuz: Genotsid natijasida ko'p bolalar yetim qoldi.

def: Biror kishi yoki narsaga zararli yoki xavfli ta'sir qilish.
ex: The ship was hit by a violent storm.
exuz: Kema qattiq bo'ronga duch keldi.

def: Muhim yoki zarur narsangizdan ajralish yoki u vayron bo'lishi.
ex: The family never thought they'd lose everything to fire.
exuz: Oila hamma narsani olovda yo'qotaman deb hech o'ylamagan edi.

def: Kimdir tug'ilgan va o'sgan joyga tegishli.
ex: Carlos is a hero in his native country of Brazil.
exuz: Karlos o'z ona yurti Braziliyada qahramon.

def: Biror narsaning yuzdan biriga teng miqdor.
ex: Liz needs to get 80 percent on her test to pass the course.
exuz: Lizga kursdan o'tish uchun testdan 80 foiz olish kerak.

def: Biror narsa nima uchun shunday ekanini tushuntiradigan fakt yoki gap.
ex: The reason Eric is late for work is that he forgot to set his alarm.
exuz: Erik ishga kechikishining sababi — budilnikni qo'yishni unutgani.

def: Biror narsa yoki kimgadir ishora qilish.
ex: My supervisor made a reference to the data I'd collected.
exuz: Rahbarim men yig'gan ma'lumotlarga ishora qildi.

def: Biror narsa shaharlarga aloqador.
ex: It is common to see tall buildings in urban areas.
exuz: Shahar hududlarida baland binolarni ko'rish odatiy hol.

def: Biror narsani energiya manbai sifatida ishlatish.
ex: Running is good exercise for people who want to burn fat and lose weight.
exuz: Yugurish yog'ni yoqib, ozmoqchi bo'lganlar uchun yaxshi mashq.

def: Biror narsa to'g'ri, rost yoki ruxsat etilganmi, deb kimdandir so'rash.
ex: Peter wants to check with the teacher to see if he is doing the assignment right.
exuz: Piter topshiriqni to'g'ri bajarayotganini ustozdan so'rab bilmoqchi.

def: Qattiq po'choqli va oq go'shtli katta jigarrang meva.
ex: A coconut produces a healthy oil.
exuz: Kokosdan foydali yog' olinadi.

def: Miyaga ta'sir qiladigan, qisqa vaqt hushdan ketishga olib keladigan kasallik.
ex: The doctor diagnosed the patient with epilepsy.
exuz: Shifokor bemorga epilepsiya tashxisini qo'ydi.

def: Ovqatdagi yog'li qattiq yoki suyuq modda.
ex: The fat contained in salmon, avocados, and nuts is healthy.
exuz: Losos, avokado va yong'oqdagi yog' foydali.

def: Asta-sekin sifat yoki tuyg'uga ega bo'lish.
ex: Winning the award will help Steven gain confidence.
exuz: Mukofotni yutish Stivenga o'ziga ishonch orttirishga yordam beradi.

def: O'simlik va mevalarda bo'ladigan tabiiy shakar.
ex: People with diabetes need to check their glucose levels.
exuz: Diabeti borlar glyukoza darajasini tekshirib turishi kerak.

def: Biror narsa odatdagidan ko'proq bo'lsa.
ex: The thermometer shows a high body temperature.
exuz: Termometr tana haroratining yuqoriligini ko'rsatmoqda.

def: Muayyan holatda yoki o'rinda qolish.
ex: Brian needs to keep working in order to finish his project on time.
exuz: Brayan loyihasini o'z vaqtida tugatish uchun ishlashda davom etishi kerak.

def: Odamlar biladigan yoki kashf qilgan narsa.
ex: Bob is known throughout the neighborhood as a burglar.
exuz: Bob butun mahallada o'g'ri sifatida tanilgan.

def: Safro ishlab chiqaradigan va qonni tozalaydigan tanadagi katta a'zo.
ex: The professor showed us what the human liver looks like.
exuz: Professor bizga inson jigari qanday ko'rinishini ko'rsatdi.

def: Biror narsa odatdagidan kichik yoki kam.
ex: The temperature gets very low in the winter.
exuz: Qishda harorat juda pasayadi.

def: Biror narsani nazorat qilish va u bilan shug'ullanish jarayoni.
ex: Practicing yoga is good for stress management.
exuz: Yoga bilan shug'ullanish stressni boshqarish uchun foydali.

def: O'simlik yoki hayvonlar ovqat va suvdan energiya oladigan kimyoviy jarayonga aloqador.
ex: Fish have a very high metabolic rate.
exuz: Baliqlarning moddalar almashinuvi juda tez.

def: O'simlik yoki ba'zi hayvonlardan olinadigan, ayniqsa ovqat pishirishda ishlatiladigan quyuq suyuqlik.
ex: The chef put the oil in the pan and heated it up.
exuz: Oshpaz yog'ni tovaga solib qizdirdi.

def: Tuxum shaklidagi kichik qora yoki yashil meva.
ex: I prepared a bowl of olives for my guests.
exuz: Mehmonlarim uchun bir kosa zaytun tayyorladim.

def: Kimdir yoki nimadir qanday ishlashi, bajarishi.
ex: Liam's performance in the race was not his best.
exuz: Liamning poygadagi natijasi eng yaxshisi emas edi.

def: Biror narsa kuchli ta'sirga ega.
ex: This perfume has a powerful scent.
exuz: Bu atirning hidi kuchli.

def: Tanaga energiya beradigan, bug'doy, kartoshka, guruchda bo'ladigan modda.
ex: Pasta is high in starch.
exuz: Pastada kraxmal ko'p.

def: Biror narsa haqidagi asosiy ma'lumot bor qisqa bayon.
ex: Cindy concluded the meeting with a summary of the project.
exuz: Sindi yig'ilishni loyiha xulosasi bilan yakunladi.

def: Biror narsa mantiq va fikrlashga aloqador bo'lsa.
ex: The analytic article criticized the new plan and presented one of its own.
exuz: Tahliliy maqola yangi rejani tanqid qilib, o'z rejasini taklif etdi.

def: Ancha katta joy.
ex: He was very familiar with the local area.
exuz: U mahalliy hududni juda yaxshi bilardi.

def: Uylanmagan erkak.
ex: Since he was a bachelor, Jason did his shopping by himself.
exuz: Jeyson bo'ydoq bo'lgani uchun xaridni o'zi qilardi.

def: Biror narsa o'rganish va bilishga aloqador bo'lsa.
ex: After her physical examination, her cognitive skills were tested.
exuz: Jismoniy tekshiruvdan keyin uning bilish qobiliyatlari sinaldi.

def: Ikki narsaning bir-biriga urilishi.
ex: The collision between the two cars created a loud noise.
exuz: Ikki mashina to'qnashuvi baland shovqin chiqardi.

def: Muvaffaqiyatli fikrlay yoki harakat qila oladigan odam.
ex: Competent employees are much better than unknowledgeable ones.
exuz: Malakali xodimlar bilimsizlardan ancha yaxshi.

def: Kimdir o'qishni tugatganini tasdiqlovchi hujjat.
ex: After four years of college, Mary finally had a diploma.
exuz: To'rt yillik kollejdan keyin Meri nihoyat diplomga ega bo'ldi.

def: Biror fan yoki mashg'ulotda juda yaxshi bo'lish.
ex: Jenny excels at playing the piano.
exuz: Jenni pianino chalishda juda mohir.

def: Yerning tabiiy tuzilishi va ularning o'zgarishini o'rganadigan fan.
ex: Because he studied geology, he knew how the mountains were formed.
exuz: U geologiyani o'rgangani uchun tog'lar qanday hosil bo'lganini bilardi.

def: Butunning muhim qismi bo'lgan narsa.
ex: She is an integral member of our team.
exuz: U jamoamizning ajralmas a'zosi.

def: Odamning narsalarni oson tushunish qobiliyati.
ex: She was known for her quick and strong intellect as well as her beauty.
exuz: U go'zalligi bilan birga tez va kuchli aql-zakovati bilan mashhur edi.

def: Pul topish uchun qiladigan ishingiz.
ex: He now has a high-paying job.
exuz: Uning hozir yuqori maoshli ishi bor.

def: Kimdir keen bo'lsa, u aqlli.
ex: Only a keen student could have solved that math problem.
exuz: Faqat o'tkir zehnli o'quvchi o'sha matematik masalani yecha olardi.

def: Eng kichik miqdor.
ex: What is the minimum temperature in winter in this area?
exuz: Bu hududda qishdagi eng past harorat qancha?

def: Miya fikr va harakatlarimizga qanday ta'sir qilishini o'rganadigan fan.
ex: The psychology of seeing is a fascinating subject.
exuz: Ko'rish psixologiyasi qiziqarli mavzu.

def: Biror narsa radiatsiya chiqarsa yoki unga aloqador bo'lsa.
ex: Radioactive states can be very bad for anyone's health.
exuz: Radioaktiv holatlar har kimning sog'lig'iga juda zararli bo'lishi mumkin.

def: Albert Eynshteyn yaratgan vaqt va makon haqidagi g'oyalar to'plami.
ex: Relativity teaches that light travels at the same speed throughout the universe.
exuz: Nisbiylik nazariyasi yorug'lik butun koinotda bir xil tezlikda harakatlanishini o'rgatadi.

def: Inson jamiyati, uning tashkilotlari va muammolarini o'rganadigan fan.
ex: Sociology teaches that people's problems are a result of their society.
exuz: Sotsiologiya odamlarning muammolari jamiyat natijasi ekanini o'rgatadi.

def: Tajribaga emas, nazariyaga asoslangan narsa.
ex: His conclusion was only theoretical and not meant to be publicized.
exuz: Uning xulosasi faqat nazariy edi va ommaga e'lon qilish uchun mo'ljallanmagan.

def: Kuchli va sog'lom bo'lmagan odam.
ex: She is still weak after the illness.
exuz: Kasallikdan keyin u hali ham zaif.

def: Biznes, kompaniya yoki tashkilotni boshqaradigan odam.
ex: Everyone in the store did whatever the administrator asked them to.
exuz: Do'kondagi hamma ma'mur so'ragan narsani qildi.

def: Odam badavlat bo'lsa.
ex: People in the city are usually more affluent than people in the country.
exuz: Shahardagi odamlar odatda qishloqdagilardan boyroq bo'ladi.

def: Odam yoki biznesning moliyaviy hujjatlarini ko'rib chiqish.
ex: The government usually audits companies that report lower than usual incomes.
exuz: Hukumat odatda odatdagidan past daromad ko'rsatgan kompaniyalarni tekshiradi.

def: Ishni mashina yoki kompyuterga topshirish.
ex: When the bank automated, it started installing ATM machines.
exuz: Bank avtomatlashtirilganda bankomatlar o'rnata boshladi.

def: Kimnidir pul evaziga qonunga xilof ish qilishga ko'ndirish.
ex: The judge was bribed so that she would set the suspect free.
exuz: Sudya gumondorni ozod qilishi uchun pora berildi.

def: Pul yoki shuhrat uchun qonunni buzadigan odam.
ex: The corrupt policemen didn't arrest the man because he gave them money.
exuz: Poraxo'r politsiyachilar erkakni hibsga olmadi, chunki u ularga pul bergan.

def: Biror narsadan xalos bo'lish.
ex: He disposed of the can by throwing it into the recycle bin.
exuz: U bankani qayta ishlash qutisiga tashlab, undan qutuldi.

def: Kompaniya boshliqlari ishlaydigan bino.
ex: He took the long route to the headquarters because it was a nice day.
exuz: Kun yaxshi bo'lgani uchun u bosh ofisga uzoq yo'l bilan bordi.

def: Odamni biror ishni qilishga undaydigan narsa.
ex: The chance of winning a prize was an incentive to get people to play the game.
exuz: Sovrin yutish imkoniyati odamlarni o'yin o'ynashga undovchi rag'bat edi.

def: Jamiyat yoki biznesni ishlatish uchun kerak bo'lgan xizmatlar to'plami.
ex: Power lines are important parts of a city's infrastructure.
exuz: Elektr liniyalari shahar infratuzilmasining muhim qismi.

def: Qonunlarni yaratish.
ex: Senators have to legislate fairly so most people will enjoy the benefits.
exuz: Senatorlar ko'pchilik foyda ko'rishi uchun adolatli qonun chiqarishi kerak.

def: Biror narsa qonunga ko'ra ruxsat etilgan.
ex: She found a legitimate plan to raise extra funds for her vacation.
exuz: U ta'tili uchun qo'shimcha pul yig'ishning qonuniy rejasini topdi.

def: Biror narsani mohirlik bilan yoki nohaq boshqarish yoki unga ta'sir qilish.
ex: The doctor manipulated the data to make it look like the cure was working.
exuz: Shifokor davo ishlayotgandek ko'rinishi uchun ma'lumotlarni soxtalashtirdi.

def: Sotib olish yoki sotish uchun tayyor mahsulotlar.
ex: The store added more merchandise because there were more shoppers.
exuz: Xaridorlar ko'paygani uchun do'kon ko'proq tovar qo'shdi.

def: Mahsulotni odamlarga, ko'pincha shaxsiy foydalanish uchun, sotish.
ex: Although cheap to make, once a t-shirt reaches retail, it costs ten times as much.
exuz: Yasash arzon bo'lsa-da, futbolka chakana savdoga chiqqach, o'n barobar qimmatga tushadi.

def: Kompaniyaning topgan puli.
ex: The new products really increased the business's monthly revenue.
exuz: Yangi mahsulotlar biznesning oylik tushumini haqiqatan oshirdi.

def: Chiqindi yoki keraksiz narsalar.
ex: The floor around the garbage can was covered with all kinds of rubbish.
exuz: Axlat qutisi atrofidagi pol har xil chiqindi bilan qoplangan edi.

def: Hukumat kompaniyalarga yordam uchun beradigan pul.
ex: The official gave the company a subsidy so it could open two new factories.
exuz: Mansabdor kompaniyaga ikkita yangi zavod ochishi uchun subsidiya berdi.

def: Biror narsani sotib olish yoki sotish harakati.
ex: Because the clerk was new at the job, the simple transaction took a long time.
exuz: Sotuvchi yangi bo'lgani uchun oddiy savdo ko'p vaqt oldi.

def: Qonun, qoida yoki shartnomani buzish.
ex: I was given a ticket because the policeman said I violated a traffic law.
exuz: Politsiyachi yo'l harakati qoidasini buzganimni aytib, menga jarima yozdi.

def: Biror narsaning tuzilishi, maqsadi yoki sifatini baholash.
ex: She assessed the condition of the toy car before buying it.
exuz: U o'yinchoq mashinani sotib olishdan oldin uning holatini baholadi.

def: Kimnidir juda ajablantirish.
ex: The number of people that came to her party astonished her.
exuz: Ziyofatiga kelgan odamlar soni uni hayratda qoldirdi.

def: Biror narsani boshlash.
ex: His speech commenced with a "thank you" to all who had helped him succeed.
exuz: Uning nutqi muvaffaqiyatiga yordam bergan hammaga «rahmat» deb boshlandi.

def: Biror narsaning muhim sifatlari yoki asosiy xususiyatlari.
ex: The essence of the argument was that both sides felt they had lost money.
exuz: Bahsning mohiyati shu ediki, ikkala tomon ham pul yo'qotganini his qildi.

def: Biror narsani olib tashlash.
ex: The dentist extracted the woman's damaged tooth and put in a fake one.
exuz: Tish shifokori ayolning shikastlangan tishini sug'urib, sun'iysini qo'ydi.

def: Biror narsa juda yaxshi.
ex: This strawberry is the best I've ever had. It's fabulous.
exuz: Bu qulupnay men totgan eng yaxshisi. U ajoyib.

def: Harakat yoki ishning tezligi.
ex: In order to get to the meeting in time, he proceeded with haste.
exuz: Yig'ilishga o'z vaqtida yetib borish uchun u shoshilib ketdi.

def: Biror narsa qilishga to'satdan o'ylamay paydo bo'lgan xohish.
ex: Because of the scary noise, she had an impulse to run somewhere and hide.
exuz: Qo'rqinchli shovqin tufayli u qayergadir yugurib yashirinish istagiga tushdi.

def: Biror narsaning rivojlanishini to'xtatish.
ex: Poor reading skills will inhibit learning in a wide range of subject areas.
exuz: Yomon o'qish ko'nikmalari ko'p fanlarda o'rganishga to'sqinlik qiladi.

def: Qatordagi oxirgi yoki ikki tanlovning ikkinchisi.
ex: In the latter minutes of the game, the visitors scored the winning goal.
exuz: O'yinning oxirgi daqiqalarida mehmonlar g'alaba golini urdi.

def: Jismoniy moddaning eng kichik asosiy birligi.
ex: A tiny drop of water is made up of many billions of molecules.
exuz: Bir tomchi suv milliardlab molekuladan iborat.

def: Biror narsa hali ham sodir bo'layotgan yoki o'sayotgan bo'lsa.
ex: The development of plants is ongoing because it takes time for them to mature.
exuz: O'simliklarning rivojlanishi davom etmoqda, chunki ularning yetilishi vaqt oladi.

def: Odam o'z ishida aniq va ehtiyotkor bo'lsa.
ex: The builder was very precise about where he placed the nails.
exuz: Quruvchi mixlarni qayerga qo'yishda juda aniq edi.

def: Vaqt, makon yoki munosabatdagi yaqinlik.
ex: All the trees in the proximity of the beach had been cut down.
exuz: Sohil yaqinidagi barcha daraxtlar kesib tashlangan edi.

def: Ommaviy axborot vositalari kimgadir yoki nimagadir qaratgan e'tibor.
ex: She received a lot of publicity after her performance in the film.
exuz: U filmdagi o'yinidan keyin katta e'tibor oldi.

def: Kasallik, bahs yoki muammoning yechimi.
ex: A good remedy for a headache is an aspirin and a glass of water.
exuz: Bosh og'rig'iga yaxshi davo — aspirin va bir stakan suv.

def: Biror narsani muhim qiladigan sifat.
ex: The significance of the snowy weather was that we didn't have to go to school.
exuz: Qorli ob-havoning ahamiyati shu ediki, maktabga borishimiz shart emas edi.

def: Biror narsa boshqasidan keyin keladigan bo'lsa.
ex: The flood and the subsequent rescue of those caught in the flood were on TV.
exuz: Toshqin va undan keyingi qutqaruv ishlari televizorda ko'rsatildi.

def: Tabiiy narsaga o'xshatib yasalgan.
ex: Clothing made out of synthetic fabrics is very effective at keeping people warm.
exuz: Sun'iy matodan tikilgan kiyim odamni iliq saqlashda juda samarali.

def: Biror narsa o'limga sabab bo'lsa yoki o'limga olib borsa.
ex: Since his condition was not terminal, he felt a great sense of relief.
exuz: Uning kasalligi o'limga olib kelmasligi uchun u katta yengillik his qildi.

def: Yomon narsa juda jiddiy va kuchli bo'lsa.
ex: When she fell out of the tree, the girl felt an acute pain in her arm.
exuz: Qiz daraxtdan yiqilganda, qo'lida o'tkir og'riqni his qildi.

def: Boshqalarga nisbatan yomon yoki zo'ravon xatti-harakat.
ex: The problem was only made worse by Mark's aggression.
exuz: Markning tajovuzkorligi muammoni faqat yomonlashtirdi.

def: Birovning hayoti haqida boshqa odam yozgan bayon.
ex: We read a biography about Charles Darwin in science class.
exuz: Fan darsida Charlz Darvin haqidagi tarjimai holni o'qidik.

def: Biror narsani ko'paytirish yoki yaxshilash.
ex: Lowering prices boosts customers' interest in shopping.
exuz: Narxlarni tushirish xaridorlarning xarid qilishga qiziqishini oshiradi.

def: Mamnunlik bildirish yoki e'tibor jalb qilish uchun qo'llarni bir-biriga urish.
ex: After the speech, everyone in the crowd clapped their hands for the speaker.
exuz: Nutqdan keyin olomondagi hamma notiq uchun qarsak chaldi.

def: Mashhur musiqaga qaraganda rasmiyroq va jiddiyroq.
ex: Beethoven is a composer of classical music.
exuz: Betxoven klassik musiqa bastakori.

def: Kimnidir biror ishni qilishga majbur qilish.
ex: Traffic signs compel drivers to drive safely.
exuz: Yo'l belgilari haydovchilarni xavfsiz haydashga majbur qiladi.

def: Yangi, original yasalgan narsa.
ex: We saw the creation of a new political party.
exuz: Biz yangi siyosiy partiyaning tashkil topishini ko'rdik.

def: Odamning boshqalardan kuchliroq bo'lish holati.
ex: Large gorillas hit their chests to express their dominance over others.
exuz: Katta gorillalar boshqalar ustidan ustunligini ko'rsatish uchun ko'kragiga uradi.

def: Biror narsa juda yoqimli va jozibali.
ex: The girl picked out a gorgeous dress to wear to the dance.
exuz: Qiz raqsga kiyish uchun ajoyib go'zal libos tanladi.

def: Biror narsa albatta bo'ladi yoki oldini olib bo'lmaydi.
ex: It is inevitable that the days will get longer in the summer.
exuz: Yozda kunlar uzayishi muqarrar.

def: O'tmishdagi odam yoki narsa tufayli mavjud bo'lgan ta'sir.
ex: The legacy of the ancient Egyptians can be seen in their monuments.
exuz: Qadimgi misrliklar merosini ularning yodgorliklarida ko'rish mumkin.

def: Juda yaxshi rasm, roman, film yoki boshqa asar.
ex: The Arc de Triomphe is considered a masterpiece in the world of architecture.
exuz: Triumf arkasi me'morchilik olamida durdona hisoblanadi.

def: Ko'p narsa bo'lsa.
ex: When the stunt went wrong, the man suffered multiple injuries.
exuz: Hiyla noto'g'ri ketganda erkak bir nechta jarohat oldi.

def: Hikoyani yozish yoki ovoz chiqarib o'qish.
ex: This story was written by John, but Aaron is narrating it to the crowd.
exuz: Bu hikoyani Jon yozgan, lekin Aaron uni olomonga aytib bermoqda.

def: Biror yomon narsa uchun hammaga ma'lum bo'lgan.
ex: This area of town is notorious for gang activity.
exuz: Shaharning bu hududi to'dalar faoliyati bilan yomon nom chiqargan.

def: Biror narsa haqida butunlay o'ylanganda.
ex: Overall, the party was a huge success.
exuz: Umuman olganda, ziyofat katta muvaffaqiyat bo'ldi.

def: Bir narsani boshqasidan afzal ko'rish xususiyati.
ex: She has a partiality for walking to school instead of driving.
exuz: U maktabga mashinada emas, piyoda borishni ko'proq yoqtiradi.

def: Rejalashtirilmagan, to'satdan sodir bo'ladigan harakat.
ex: My wife made a spontaneous decision to buy a new sofa while I was at work.
exuz: Men ishda paytimda xotinim to'satdan yangi divan sotib olishga qaror qildi.

def: Yaxshi xislat yoki o'zini tutish usuli.
ex: My best virtue is forgiveness.
exuz: Mening eng yaxshi fazilatim — kechira olishim.

def: Biror narsaning bir qismi yoki xususiyati.
ex: I thought about the different aspects of owning two dogs.
exuz: Men ikkita it asrashning turli jihatlari haqida o'yladim.

def: Foydali yoki qimmatli ko'nikma yoki sifat.
ex: The coach realized the boy's speed was an asset to the team.
exuz: Murabbiy bolaning tezligi jamoa uchun katta boylik ekanini angladi.

def: Sizga beriladigan vazifa.
ex: He was given a difficult assignment but he felt he could succeed in doing it.
exuz: Unga qiyin topshiriq berildi, lekin u uddalay olishini his qildi.

def: Vaziyat yoki fakt haqida bilim yoki tasavvur.
ex: She has little awareness of what needs to be done.
exuz: Uning nima qilish kerakligi haqida xabardorligi kam.

def: O'simlikning gul yoki bargga aylanadigan qismi.
ex: Two weeks after planting the seed, a small bud appeared.
exuz: Urug' ekilgandan ikki hafta o'tgach, kichik g'uncha paydo bo'ldi.

def: Turli qismlarni birgalikda ishlashga keltirish.
ex: Each skating team had to coordinate their movements for the show.
exuz: Har bir uchish jamoasi shou uchun harakatlarini muvofiqlashtirishi kerak edi.

def: Sizning foydangizga bo'lgan narsa.
ex: His bank account is in credit, so he has money he can spend.
exuz: Uning bank hisobi plyusda, shuning uchun sarflaydigan puli bor.

def: Biror narsaning noto'g'ri ekanini ko'rsatish.
ex: The scientist disproved the theory that the sun moved around the Earth.
exuz: Olim quyosh Yer atrofida aylanadi degan nazariyani rad etdi.

def: Odamlar hayotiga yordam berishga oid.
ex: After the flood, several humanitarian organizations offered help.
exuz: Toshqindan keyin bir necha insonparvarlik tashkiloti yordam taklif qildi.

def: Hali isbotlanmagan g'oya.
ex: The teacher did an experiment to prove whether his hypothesis was right.
exuz: Ustoz o'z gipotezasi to'g'ri yoki yo'qligini isbotlash uchun tajriba o'tkazdi.

def: Biror narsa ko'p ma'lumot bersa.
ex: The travel guide had a lot of informative facts about the region.
exuz: Sayohat qo'llanmasida mintaqa haqida ko'p foydali ma'lumotlar bor edi.

def: Ko'z yoki yorug'likka tegishli.
ex: Her blindness was caused by a problem with her optic nerve.
exuz: Uning ko'rligiga ko'rish nervidagi muammo sabab bo'lgan.

def: Biror narsa asoslangan g'oya.
ex: The premise of the movie that Bobbi and I watched was unrealistic.
exuz: Bobbi bilan ko'rgan filmimizning asosiy g'oyasi haqiqatga to'g'ri kelmasdi.

def: Narsalarni ushlab turadigan tokchalari bor buyum.
ex: He stored his tools on a rack.
exuz: U asboblarini javonda saqladi.

def: 14 va 17-asrlar orasidagi davr.
ex: Leonardo da Vinci was a popular artist of the Renaissance.
exuz: Leonardo da Vinchi Uyg'onish davrining mashhur rassomi edi.

def: Biror narsa joylashuv va hajmga oid.
ex: He was asked where the books were located to test his spatial awareness.
exuz: Uning fazoviy tasavvurini sinash uchun kitoblar qayerda ekani so'ralgan.

def: Biror narsani aniq tasvirlab berish.
ex: The poster didn't specify where the concert was taking place.
exuz: Plakatda konsert qayerda bo'lishi aniq ko'rsatilmagan edi.

def: Ikki narsani arqon, ip va hokazo bilan mahkamlash.
ex: The dog is used to being tied up.
exuz: It bog'lab qo'yilishga o'rganib qolgan.

def: Biror ishni qilish mas'uliyatini o'z zimmasiga olish.
ex: We undertook to make sure everybody was well informed of current progress.
exuz: Biz hammaning joriy yutuqlardan to'liq xabardor bo'lishiga javobgar bo'ldik.

def: Biroz yaltiroq, qizdirilganda eriydigan modda.
ex: The candles are made of wax.
exuz: Shamlar mumdan yasalgan.

def: Biror ishni to'xtata olmaydigan odam.
ex: She was a coffee addict. She had more than three cups each day.
exuz: U qahvaga o'rganib qolgan edi. Har kuni uch piyoladan ko'p ichardi.

def: Arxeologiyaga oid narsa.
ex: They found archeological evidence of an ancient species of man.
exuz: Ular qadimiy inson turiga oid arxeologik dalil topishdi.

def: Qadimgi odamlarni ularning buyumlari orqali o'rganadigan fan.
ex: He studied archeology to learn more about ancient Egyptian culture.
exuz: U qadimgi Misr madaniyati haqida ko'proq bilish uchun arxeologiyani o'rgandi.

def: Biror mavzu haqida ko'p g'oyalar aytish.
ex: The students met after school to brainstorm ideas for their assignments.
exuz: O'quvchilar topshiriqlari uchun g'oyalar o'ylash maqsadida darsdan keyin yig'ilishdi.

def: Biror narsaga sarflash uchun mavjud pul miqdori.
ex: His budget for food was very tight.
exuz: Uning ovqatga byudjeti juda tor edi.

def: Biror narsa aqldan ozgan, chalkash va shoshilinch bo'lsa.
ex: The first day of school can be chaotic for a new student.
exuz: Maktabning birinchi kuni yangi o'quvchi uchun tartibsiz bo'lishi mumkin.

def: Biror narsaning misoli yoki isboti sifatida eslatib o'tish.
ex: She cited six reasons that the school needed to build new classrooms.
exuz: U maktabga yangi sinf xonalari qurish kerakligining oltita sababini keltirdi.

def: Biror narsaga mos kelish yoki o'xshash bo'lish.
ex: The boy's story didn't correspond with his mother's version.
exuz: Bolaning hikoyasi onasining aytganlariga mos kelmadi.

def: Bino devorlari bilan o'ralgan ochiq joy.
ex: During the summer, the courtyard is a nice place to have lunch.
exuz: Yozda hovli tushlik qilish uchun yoqimli joy.

def: Oila yoki tashkilot egalik qiladigan katta yer maydoni.
ex: He lived on his father's estate in the country.
exuz: U otasining qishloqdagi mulkida yashadi.

def: Yolg'on yoki aldov orqali pul olish jinoyati.
ex: Experts say that credit card fraud increases around the holidays.
exuz: Mutaxassislar kredit karta firibgarligi bayramlar atrofida ko'payishini aytadi.

def: Ta'mi, rangi va hidi bo'lmagan gaz.
ex: Airships used to be filled with hydrogen, but it exploded easily.
exuz: Dirijablar ilgari vodorod bilan to'ldirilgan, lekin u oson portlagan.

def: Halollik va yaxshi axloq.
ex: The principal had a lot of integrity.
exuz: Direktor juda halol edi.

def: Odamning biror narsa haqidagi fikri yoki o'ylash usuli.
ex: He changed his outlook about rats after he read a book about them.
exuz: U kalamushlar haqidagi kitobni o'qigach, ularga qarashini o'zgartirdi.

def: Odam va narsalarni yerga xavfsiz tushiradigan qurilma.
ex: They used parachutes dropped from airplanes to send supplies to the civilians.
exuz: Ular samolyotlardan tashlangan parashyutlar yordamida tinch aholiga yordam yetkazishdi.

def: Yozma tarixdan oldingi davrga oid narsa.
ex: The scientists found prehistoric pots used by the people in the area.
exuz: Olimlar hududdagi odamlar ishlatgan tarixdan oldingi idishlarni topdilar.

def: G'oya yoki rejani qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan odam.
ex: He was a proponent of using environmentally-friendly products.
exuz: U atrof-muhitga zarar qilmaydigan mahsulotlardan foydalanish tarafdori edi.

def: Biror narsani o'zgartirishlar kiritib yaxshilash.
ex: The principal refined his method of controlling students over the years.
exuz: Direktor yillar davomida o'quvchilarni boshqarish usulini takomillashtirdi.

def: Biror narsani cheklab, kattalashishiga yo'l qo'ymaslik.
ex: The club restricted the amount of members.
exuz: Klub a'zolar sonini cheklab qo'ydi.

def: Yaqin hamkorlikda ishlaydigan odamlar guruhi.
ex: The All Blacks are my favorite sports team.
exuz: «Ol Blekslar» mening sevimli sport jamoam.

def: Biror narsa kichikroq miqdorlarning qo'shilishidan iborat.
ex: The company totaled its aggregate sales for the entire year.
exuz: Kompaniya butun yil bo'yicha umumiy savdosini hisobladi.

def: Bakteriyalarni o'ldirish va infeksiyani davolash uchun ishlatiladigan dori.
ex: The doctor gave me a shot of an antibiotic when I got the flu.
exuz: Gripp bo'lganimda shifokor menga antibiotik ukol qildi.

def: Elektr oqimiga imkon beradigan elektron qurilma qismi.
ex: Be very careful not to shock yourself when fixing an electrical circuit.
exuz: Elektr zanjirini tuzatayotganda o'zingizni tok urishidan ehtiyot bo'ling.

def: Biror narsa yoki kimnidir yaxshiroq qilish.
ex: The wool scarf complemented her lovely eyes.
exuz: Jun sharf uning go'zal ko'zlarini to'ldirib turardi.

def: Biror narsani joyni kam egallashi uchun bosish.
ex: I compressed my clothes to fit into a single suitcase.
exuz: Kiyimlarimni bitta chemodanga sig'dirish uchun siqib joyladim.

def: Kompyuterda saqlangan ma'lumotlar to'plami.
ex: The company has a database of all the names and accounts of their customers.
exuz: Kompaniyada barcha mijozlarining ismi va hisoblari ma'lumotlar bazasi bor.

def: Boshqa miqdor yoki qiymat bilan bir xil bo'lgan miqdor.
ex: I worked the equivalent of sixty hours this week.
exuz: Bu hafta men oltmish soatga teng ishladim.

def: Odam kasallikka chalinmasligi mumkin bo'lsa.
ex: Children usually get shots to make them immune to certain diseases.
exuz: Bolalarga ma'lum kasalliklarga qarshi immunitet hosil qilish uchun odatda emlash qilinadi.

def: Kompyuterga kiritiladigan ma'lumot.
ex: Type the input into the computer program.
exuz: Ma'lumotni kompyuter dasturiga kiriting.

def: Aloqa juda yaqin bo'lsa.
ex: I only tell my secrets to my most intimate friends.
exuz: Men sirlarimni faqat eng yaqin do'stlarimga aytaman.

def: Temirni o'ziga tortadigan temir yoki boshqa material bo'lagi.
ex: I used a magnet to pick up the nails that were scattered on the floor.
exuz: Men poldagi sochilib ketgan mixlarni terib olish uchun magnitdan foydalandim.

def: Tanadagi energiya olish uchun kimyoviy jarayonlar.
ex: If you exercise every day, your metabolism speeds up.
exuz: Har kuni mashq qilsangiz, moddalar almashinuvingiz tezlashadi.

def: Ma'lumot saqlaydigan kompyuterdagi kichik qurilma.
ex: I can put more data on my computer if I buy a more powerful microchip.
exuz: Kuchliroq mikrochip sotib olsam, kompyuterimga ko'proq ma'lumot sig'diraman.

def: Jarayonning bir davri yoki biror narsaning asta-sekin rivojlanishi.
ex: The first phase of the recycling project involves finding volunteers to help out.
exuz: Qayta ishlash loyihasining birinchi bosqichi yordam beradigan ko'ngillilarni topishni o'z ichiga oladi.

def: Barmoqlar orasiga teri bo'lagini olib siqish.
ex: I pinched my nose so I couldn't smell the odor from the garbage.
exuz: Axlat hidini sezmaslik uchun burnimni qisib oldim.

def: Biror narsa odatiy bo'lsa.
ex: Growing a beard is more prevalent in some countries than in others.
exuz: Soqol qo'yish ba'zi mamlakatlarda boshqalaridagidan ko'proq tarqalgan.

def: Atom zarrachalarining xatti-harakatiga oid.
ex: The physics student studied quantum mechanics.
exuz: Fizika talabasi kvant mexanikasini o'rgandi.

def: Ikki narsa o'rtasidagi son yoki miqdor bilan ifodalangan bog'liqlik.
ex: The boy-to-girl ratio is one to three.
exuz: O'g'il va qiz bolalar nisbati bir ga uch.

def: Silindr atrofida aylanib boradigan shakl.
ex: A strand of DNA looks like two interlocking spirals.
exuz: DNK zanjiri bir-biriga o'ralgan ikki spiralga o'xshaydi.

def: Biror narsa virus keltirib chiqargan kasallik yoki infeksiya.
ex: The girl was in bed for a week when she had a viral infection.
exuz: Qiz virusli infeksiya bo'lganida bir hafta yotib qoldi.

def: Boshqa moddalarni kuydirishi yoki eritishi mumkin bo'lgan kimyoviy modda.
ex: In chemistry class, we mixed two acids together and watched the reaction.
exuz: Kimyo darsida ikki kislotani aralashtirib, reaksiyani kuzatdik.

def: Kompaniya yoki tashkilotni boshqaradigan odamlar guruhi.
ex: She hoped she could be promoted to a job in administration.
exuz: U ma'muriyatdagi ishga ko'tarilishiga umid qilardi.

def: Kompaniya yoki tashkilotni boshqarishga oid.
ex: I work as an administrative assistant to the owner of the company.
exuz: Men kompaniya egasining ma'muriy yordamchisi bo'lib ishlayman.

def: Hujayra kabi tirik qismlarni sanoat va texnologiyada ishlatish.
ex: Researchers at the biotechnology company use bacteria to make medicine.
exuz: Biotexnologiya kompaniyasi tadqiqotchilari dori yasash uchun bakteriyalardan foydalanadi.

def: Hayvonlarning yog'i, to'qimasi va qonida bo'ladigan modda.
ex: When people have too much cholesterol, they are at a high risk for heart problems.
exuz: Odamda xolesterin ko'p bo'lsa, yurak muammolari xavfi yuqori.

def: Umumiy maqsad uchun ishlaydigan odamlar yoki tashkilotlar guruhi.
ex: The companies formed a coalition to make trade less expensive.
exuz: Kompaniyalar savdoni arzonlashtirish uchun ittifoq tuzdi.

def: Biror narsa yolg'onga ishontiradigan bo'lsa.
ex: The scary-looking man's appearance is deceptive; he is actually very nice.
exuz: Qo'rqinchli ko'rinishli erkakning tashqi qiyofasi aldamchi; aslida u juda yaxshi.

def: Odam tanasi qondagi shakar darajasini boshqara olmaydigan tibbiy holat.
ex: Overweight people are more likely to suffer from diabetes than slimmer ones.
exuz: Ortiqcha vaznli odamlar ozg'in odamlarga qaraganda diabetdan ko'proq aziyat chekadi.

def: Keraksiz narsani butunlay olib tashlash.
ex: Wearing a seatbelt eliminates some of the dangers of driving a car.
exuz: Xavfsizlik kamarini taqish mashina haydashdagi ba'zi xavflarni bartaraf etadi.

def: Oqayotgan suv yoki ob-havo tufayli tosh yoki tuproqning buzilishi.
ex: Canyons are formed because rivers of fast-moving water caused erosion.
exuz: Kanyonlar tez oqadigan daryolar emirilish keltirib chiqargani uchun hosil bo'ladi.

def: To'g'ri va noto'g'ri haqidagi axloqiy e'tiqod yoki qoidalar.
ex: The act of stealing certainly doesn't go against some people's ethics.
exuz: O'g'irlik qilish ba'zi odamlarning axloq qoidalariga zid emas.

def: Biror narsa juda aniq, ochiq va rost bo'lsa.
ex: The man gave a very explicit account of the car accident.
exuz: Erkak avtohalokat haqida juda aniq hikoya qilib berdi.

def: Odamlar muammolarni hal qilish uchun ishlatadigan qoida yoki g'oyalar to'plami.
ex: His ideas fit into the framework of a successful business plan.
exuz: Uning g'oyalari muvaffaqiyatli biznes reja asosiga mos tushdi.

def: Biror narsani zavodda yasash.
ex: My father's company manufactures steel building materials.
exuz: Dadamning kompaniyasi po'lat qurilish materiallarini ishlab chiqaradi.

def: Mashinaning ma'lum vazifani bajaradigan qismi.
ex: I can't open my car door because the locking mechanism is broke.
exuz: Mashinam eshigini och olmayapman, chunki qulf mexanizmi buzilgan.

def: Biror narsani iloji boricha kam qilish.
ex: I checked my homework twice to minimize errors I might have made.
exuz: Xatolarni kamaytirish uchun uy vazifamni ikki marta tekshirdim.

def: Asalarilar va boshqa hasharotlar yig'adigan gullar ishlab chiqargan shirin suyuqlik.
ex: Bees use nectar to make their honey.
exuz: Asalarilar asal qilish uchun nektardan foydalanadi.

def: Biror narsa haqidagi g'oya yoki ishonch.
ex: I had a notion that this route would get us to the beach.
exuz: Menda bu yo'l bizni dengiz bo'yiga olib boradi degan fikr bor edi.

def: Hukumat yoki boshqaruv tizimi.
ex: He was a member of the old regime that had been overthrown in the election.
exuz: U saylovda ag'darilgan eski tuzum a'zosi edi.

def: Biror narsa tushunish oson bo'lgani uchun yaxshi.
ex: The teacher's grading system was straightforward and fair.
exuz: Ustozning baholash tizimi oddiy va adolatli edi.

def: Biror kishi qarzlarini to'lay olmasa.
ex: The store had few customers and soon went bankrupt.
exuz: Do'konning mijozlari kam edi va tez orada bankrot bo'ldi.

def: Qoida yoki qonunlarga amal qilish.
ex: The new student had to conform to the school's dress code.
exuz: Yangi o'quvchi maktabning kiyinish qoidasiga rioya qilishi kerak edi.

def: Kimgadir ish berish.
ex: The bookstore employed two full-time clerks.
exuz: Kitob do'koni ikkita to'liq kunlik sotuvchini ishga oldi.

def: Kimnidir majburan joydan ketkazish.
ex: Since he would not follow the rules, the principal had to expel the student.
exuz: U qoidalarga amal qilmagani uchun direktor o'quvchini haydashga majbur bo'ldi.

def: Biror narsaga ko'proq joy yoki vaqt berish uchun qo'shilgan qism.
ex: My parents decided to add an extension to our house for the new baby.
exuz: Ota-onam yangi chaqaloq uchun uyimizga qo'shimcha xona qurishga qaror qildi.

def: Kelajakda bo'ladigan narsa.
ex: Some economists predicted that the forthcoming world economy would be severe.
exuz: Ba'zi iqtisodchilar kelajakdagi jahon iqtisodiyoti og'ir bo'lishini bashorat qildi.

def: Uy yoki xonaga mebel qo'yish.
ex: Most homes are furnished with tables, chairs, and beds.
exuz: Ko'p uylar stol, stul va karavot bilan jihozlangan.

def: Salomatlik va tozalik uchun kerakli sharoit yoki usullar.
ex: People who brush their teeth at least twice a day are practicing good hygiene.
exuz: Kuniga kamida ikki marta tish yuvadigan odamlar gigiyenaga rioya qiladi.

def: Biror narsa toza va kasallik keltirmaydigan bo'lsa.
ex: My sister works very hard to keep her entire home as hygienic as possible.
exuz: Singlim butun uyini iloji boricha toza saqlash uchun juda ko'p mehnat qiladi.

def: Odamga mulkni ijaraga beradigan kishi.
ex: The landlord collected everyone's rent money on the first day of every month.
exuz: Uy egasi har oyning birinchi kuni hammaning ijara pulini yig'ib oldi.

def: Mulk, odatda kvartira yoki yerni ijaraga olish.
ex: When the family first leased the apartment, the rent was very low.
exuz: Oila kvartirani birinchi marta ijaraga olganda ijara haqi juda past edi.

def: Biror narsa qonun bilan talab qilinsa.
ex: It's mandatory that everyone be at least 16 to drive a car in the US.
exuz: AQShda mashina haydash uchun hamma kamida 16 yoshda bo'lishi majburiy.

def: Biror narsa buzilgan yoki shikastlanganda uni tuzatish.
ex: Mother mended the rip in my pants with a piece of cloth.
exuz: Onam shimimdagi yirtiqni mato bo'lagi bilan yamadi.

def: Mulk, ayniqsa uy yoki biznes uchun olingan qarz.
ex: When they bought their new home, the married couple had to sign a mortgage.
exuz: Yangi uy sotib olganlarida er-xotin ipoteka shartnomasini imzolashga majbur bo'ldi.

def: Biznesdagi ishchilar.
ex: When business increased, we had to hire more personnel.
exuz: Biznes kengayganda biz ko'proq xodim yollashimiz kerak bo'ldi.

def: Uyga suv yetkazadigan quvurlar tizimi.
ex: When the plumbing stopped working, no one was allowed to use the toilets.
exuz: Santexnika ishlamay qolganda hech kimga hojatxonadan foydalanishga ruxsat berilmadi.

def: Kimdir aytgan gap yoki ish qancha turishi haqidagi narx.
ex: His writing was full of quotes from Shakespeare.
exuz: Uning yozuvi Shekspirdan olingan iqtiboslarga to'la edi.

def: Uy egasidan mulkni ijaraga olgan odam.
ex: The new tenants moved into the house across the street.
exuz: Yangi ijarachilar ko'chaning narigi tomonidagi uyga ko'chib kirishdi.

def: Suv yoki elektr kabi xizmatlar bilan ta'minlaydigan korxona.
ex: If you don't pay the utilities, you may have your electricity turned off.
exuz: Kommunal xizmatlarni to'lamasangiz, elektr o'chirilishi mumkin.

def: «Qaysi yo'l bilan» yoki «buning orqali» ma'nosida.
ex: The mayor had a new bridge built whereby the citizens could cross the river.
exuz: Hokim yangi ko'prik qurdirdi va fuqarolar daryodan shu orqali o'ta oladigan bo'ldi.

def: Yangi vaziyatga moslashish uchun o'zgarish.
ex: When he went to the new town, he had to adapt to all the weather changes.
exuz: U yangi shaharga borganda, ob-havo o'zgarishlariga moslashishiga to'g'ri keldi.

def: Hayot va tirik mavjudotlar jarayonini ifodalaydi.
ex: In science class, we learned about the biological process of bacterial growth.
exuz: Fan darsida bakteriyalar o'sishining biologik jarayoni haqida o'rgandik.

def: Hayvon yoki o'simlik hujayralariga oid.
ex: She used a microscope to see the activity at a cellular level.
exuz: U faoliyatni hujayra darajasida ko'rish uchun mikroskopdan foydalandi.

def: Odamlar jonli va ijodiy g'oyalarga ega bo'lsa.
ex: The new, dynamic employee came up with a good way to juggle his workload.
exuz: Yangi, g'ayratli xodim ish yukini taqsimlashning yaxshi yo'lini topdi.

def: Odamlar o'ylaydigan, lekin ro'yobga chiqishi qiyin yoqimli vaziyat.
ex: Becoming an astronaut is a fantasy shared by many children.
exuz: Kosmonavt bo'lish ko'p bolalarning umumiy orzusi.

def: Xususiyatlarning ota-onadan bolalarga o'tishi.
ex: The boy's face is similar to his father's because of heredity.
exuz: Bolaning yuzi irsiyat tufayli otasinikiga o'xshaydi.

def: Biror narsa ob'ekt yoki joy ichida mavjud yoki sodir bo'lsa.
ex: We removed the outer case to reveal the computer's internal wires.
exuz: Kompyuterning ichki simlarini ko'rish uchun tashqi qopqog'ini olib tashladik.

def: Biror narsa juda kichik.
ex: My lazy husband does a minimal amount of work around the house.
exuz: Dangasa erim uy atrofida eng kam ish qiladi.

def: Biror narsani birinchi bo'lib kashf qilgan yoki unda qatnashgan odam.
ex: He was a pioneer of computer programming.
exuz: U kompyuter dasturlashning kashshofi edi.

def: Kimgadir dori ichishni aytish.
ex: When I was sick, the doctor prescribed flu medicine for me to take.
exuz: Kasal bo'lganimda shifokor menga gripp dorisini buyurdi.

def: Aytilgan har bir odamga alohida taalluqli narsalar.
ex: The boxers were told to return to their respective corners.
exuz: Bokschilarga o'z burchaklariga qaytish aytildi.

def: Qoidalar yoki tizimlar o'zgartirib bo'lmagani uchun og'ir.
ex: Societies often have rigid rules about the way that people are supposed to act.
exuz: Jamiyatlarda odamlar o'zini qanday tutishi haqida ko'pincha qat'iy qoidalar bor.

def: Birin-ketin keladigan voqealar yoki narsalar soni.
ex: The dominos fell in a sequence of one after another.
exuz: Domino toshlari birin-ketin ketma-ket yiqildi.

def: Deyarli bir xil bo'lgan narsalar.
ex: I have had a similar experience to the one you described.
exuz: Siz tasvirlaganingizga o'xshash tajribani men ham boshdan kechirganman.

def: Biror narsa yoki kimnidir boshqasining o'rniga qo'yish.
ex: When I ran out of juice, I had to substitute water to drink in the morning.
exuz: Sharbat tugaganda ertalab ichish uchun uni suvga almashtirishga to'g'ri keldi.

def: Jarrohlik qilishni o'rgangan shifokor.
ex: The surgeon operated on the old man's heart.
exuz: Jarroh keksa odamning yuragini operatsiya qildi.

def: Muayyan jismoniy yoki ruhiy kasallik uchun davolash.
ex: After she broke her legs, she used physical therapy to learn how to walk again.
exuz: Oyoqlari singandan keyin u yana yurishni o'rganish uchun jismoniy terapiyadan foydalandi.

def: Biror narsani bir joydan boshqasiga ko'chirish.
ex: The family transferred the groceries from the shopping cart to the car.
exuz: Oila oziq-ovqatni xarid aravachasidan mashinaga ko'chirdi.

def: Bir shakldan boshqasiga o'zgarish jarayoni.
ex: The weather gets colder during the transition from summer to autumn.
exuz: Yozdan kuzga o'tish davrida ob-havo sovuqlashadi.

def: Shikastlangan a'zo almashtiriladigan operatsiya.
ex: The sick child needed a heart transplant to live.
exuz: Kasal bolaga yashash uchun yurak ko'chirib o'tkazish kerak edi.

def: Yulduzlar odamlar hayotiga ta'sir qiladi degan ishonch bilan ularni o'rganish.
ex: Jack, who studies astrology, believes that the stars can predict the future.
exuz: Munajjimlikni o'rganayotgan Jek yulduzlar kelajakni bashorat qila oladi deb ishonadi.

def: Birga bo'ladigan ikki narsa.
ex: There were a couple of problems I had to solve.
exuz: Men hal qilishim kerak bo'lgan ikkita muammo bor edi.

def: To'g'ri yo'ldan chetga chiqish.
ex: Very few deviate much from the average.
exuz: Juda kam odam o'rtachadan ko'p chetga chiqadi.

def: Odam yoki narsalar orasidagi farqni ko'rsatish.
ex: It was hard to differentiate between the identical twins.
exuz: Bir xil egizaklarni farqlash qiyin edi.

def: Kimdir yoki nimadir ishlashiga to'sqinlik qilish.
ex: The loud crash disrupted the class lecture.
exuz: Baland shovqin dars ma'ruzasiga xalaqit berdi.

def: Biror narsaning qiymatini topadigan matematik amal.
ex: I used the Pythagorean theorem to solve the equation.
exuz: Tenglamani yechish uchun Pifagor teoremasidan foydalandim.

def: Xatoga yo'l qo'yish.
ex: The pilot erred in his estimate of the time it would take to make the trip.
exuz: Uchuvchi safar qancha vaqt olishini baholashda xato qildi.

def: Biror narsa noto'g'ri yoki qisman to'g'ri.
ex: The child held the erroneous belief that time machines were real.
exuz: Bola vaqt mashinalari haqiqiy deb noto'g'ri ishonardi.

def: Odam yoki narsa qo'rqib, yovvoyi harakat qilsa.
ex: The cat became frantic when I tried to give it a bath.
exuz: Mushukni cho'mdirmoqchi bo'lganimda u bezovta bo'lib ketdi.

def: Harakat nima qilayotganini anglamay qilinsa.
ex: She made an inadvertent error when she knocked over the nail polish.
exuz: U tirnoq lakini ag'darib yuborib, beixtiyor xato qildi.

def: Mavjud narsa bilan yoki rejasiz biror ishni qilish.
ex: There was no meat for the pizza, so we improvised with what was in the fridge.
exuz: Pitsa uchun go'sht yo'q edi, shuning uchun muzlatgichdagi narsalar bilan hal qildik.

def: Joyning ekvatordan masofasi.
ex: The device was able to tell the traveler his exact latitude.
exuz: Qurilma sayohatchiga uning aniq kengligini ayta oldi.

def: Kemachi.
ex: The old mariner used his telescope to find the shore.
exuz: Keksa dengizchi qirg'oqni topish uchun teleskopidan foydalandi.

def: Juda ko'p odam yoki narsa.
ex: A multitude of people were waiting at the airport.
exuz: Aeroportda juda ko'p odam kutib turardi.

def: Zerikarli yoki ko'p muammo tug'diradigan odam yoki narsa.
ex: The teenager considered his noisy little brothers to be quite a nuisance.
exuz: O'smir shovqinli kichik ukalarini ancha bezovta deb hisoblardi.

def: Biror narsaning abadiy qolish qobiliyati.
ex: Poor results threaten the permanence of the new system.
exuz: Yomon natijalar yangi tizimning doimiyligiga xavf soladi.

def: Biror narsani asosiy yoki diqqat markazida ushlab turish.
ex: My life revolves around sports.
exuz: Mening hayotim sport atrofida aylanadi.

def: Jahldor yoki xafa kishini tinchlantirish.
ex: The mother soothed her crying baby by rocking him in her arms.
exuz: Ona yig'layotgan chaqaloqni qo'lida tebratib tinchlantirdi.

def: Kimdir biror joydan chiqib keta olmasa.
ex: When the plane left, my sister and I were stranded in China.
exuz: Samolyot uchib ketganda, singlim bilan men Xitoyda qolib ketdik.

def: Biror ishni qilish yo'li.
ex: There are a lot of teaching techniques that are well supported by research.
exuz: Tadqiqotlar qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan o'qitish usullari juda ko'p.

def: Biror narsa yoki kimdir kulgili bo'lsa.
ex: That group of people making animal noises sounds completely absurd.
exuz: Hayvon tovushini chiqarayotgan o'sha odamlar guruhi mutlaqo bema'ni eshitiladi.

def: Ba'zi jamiyatlardagi eng yuqori tabaqa odamlari.
ex: Most members of the aristocracy were very well fed.
exuz: Aristokratiya a'zolarining ko'pchiligi juda to'q yashar edi.

def: Ba'zi jamiyatlardagi eng yuqori tabaqadan bo'lgan odam.
ex: The aristocrat did not need a job because his family was wealthy.
exuz: Aristokratga ish kerak emas edi, chunki oilasi boy edi.

def: Chiroyli yoki maxsus kiyim.
ex: Everyone wore their best attire to the president's daughter's wedding.
exuz: Hamma prezident qizining to'yiga eng yaxshi kiyimini kiyib bordi.

def: Qisqa muddatli mashhur mashg'ulot yoki narsa.
ex: Wearing bright red socks was a craze when I was in high school.
exuz: Men maktabda o'qiganimda yorqin qizil paypoq kiyish moda edi.

def: Biror narsa boshqasining belgisi yoki o'rnini bosadi.
ex: Quotation marks are used to denote speech.
exuz: Qo'shtirnoq nutqni bildirish uchun ishlatiladi.

def: Biror narsani kattaroq qilish.
ex: The classrooms were enlarged over the summer to make room for more students.
exuz: Yozda ko'proq o'quvchiga joy bo'lishi uchun sinf xonalari kattalashtirildi.

def: Kerak yoki xohlangandan ko'p miqdordagi narsa.
ex: Because it never got cold that winter, many stores had an excess of coats.
exuz: O'sha qishda hech sovumagani uchun ko'p do'konlarda palto ortib qoldi.

def: Biror narsa ayollarga xos sifatlarga ega bo'lsa.
ex: Many of the older people thought his long hair made him look too feminine.
exuz: Keksa odamlarning ko'pchiligi uning uzun sochi uni juda ayolga o'xshatadi deb o'ylardi.

def: Narsalar yoki odamlarning bir-biridan yuqori darajada tartiblangan tizimi.
ex: Everyone knows where they fit in the hierarchy.
exuz: Hamma iyerarxiyada o'z o'rnini biladi.

def: Narsalarni himoya qilish yoki tozalash uchun ishlatiladigan qalin yumshoq material.
ex: Football players wear shoulder pads to keep them safe.
exuz: Futbolchilar xavfsizlik uchun yelka himoyasini kiyadi.

def: Siz bilan teng huquqda yashaydigan yoki ishlaydigan odam.
ex: Ladies and gentlemen, take your partners for the next dance.
exuz: Xonimlar va janoblar, keyingi raqs uchun sheriklaringizni oling.

def: Biror narsa eng muhim, keng tarqalgan yoki eng kuchli bo'lsa.
ex: Before cars were invented, horses were the predominant method of travel.
exuz: Mashinalar ixtiro qilinishidan oldin otlar sayohatning asosiy usuli edi.

def: Ishlar qanday bajarilishini boshqaradigan qoidalar va odatlar tizimi.
ex: The introduction of the guests followed the normal protocol.
exuz: Mehmonlarni tanishtirish odatiy tartib-qoidaga muvofiq bo'ldi.

def: Biror narsa yoki kimdir yaxshi obro'ga ega.
ex: The service from the less-than-reputable company made her angry.
exuz: Obro'si unchalik yaxshi bo'lmagan kompaniya xizmati uni jahlini chiqardi.

def: Biror narsaning ramzi bo'lish.
ex: A red octagon is used to signify a place to stop.
exuz: Qizil sakkizburchak to'xtash joyini bildirish uchun ishlatiladi.

def: Narsani mahkamlash, ko'tarish yoki ushlab turish uchun ishlatiladigan uzun mato tasma.
ex: She put the strap of her purse over her shoulder and walked out the door.
exuz: U sumkasining tasmasini yelkasiga tashlab, eshikdan chiqib ketdi.

def: Siz ishlarni qilish usulingiz.
ex: Her clothes were all in the latest style.
exuz: Uning kiyimlarining hammasi eng so'nggi uslubda edi.

def: Bir-biriga o'ralib qolgan narsa yoki ko'p narsalar.
ex: The laces of his shoes were in such a tangle that he could not untie them.
exuz: Uning poyabzal ipi shu qadar chigallashib ketgan ediki, uni yecha olmadi.

def: Odam o'zining tashqi ko'rinishi yoki mol-mulkidan haddan ziyod faxrlanishi.
ex: Her vanity won't allow her to pass a mirror without looking at herself.
exuz: Manmanligi uni ko'zguning yonidan o'tib, o'ziga qaramasdan ketishiga yo'l qo'ymaydi.

def: Biror narsa suvdan quruqlikka chiqsa.
ex: After a long day of fishing, Glen pulled his boat ashore, so it wouldn't float away.
exuz: Baliq ovlagan uzoq kundan keyin Glen qayig'ini oqib ketmasligi uchun sohilga tortib chiqardi.

def: Boshqa odam aytganiga qarama-qarshi gap aytish.
ex: Ken was always fighting with his little sister because she kept contradicting him.
exuz: Ken kichik singlisi bilan doim urishardi, chunki u uning gapiga zid gapirardi.

def: Ish-vazifasida boshqa narsaga juda o'xshash narsa.
ex: Our manager will meet our rival company's counterpart later today.
exuz: Menejerimiz bugun kechroq raqib kompaniyaning o'z hamkasbi bilan uchrashadi.

def: Biror narsa yoki kimdir biror narsadan mahrum bo'lsa.
ex: The movie was devoid of any violence, so it was a perfect movie for the family.
exuz: Filmda hech qanday zo'ravonlik yo'q edi, shuning uchun u oila uchun ideal film edi.

def: Boshqacha bo'lib qolish yoki boshqa yo'nalishga burilish.
ex: The road diverged into two paths that led to our houses.
exuz: Yo'l ikkiga ajralib, uylarimizga olib boruvchi ikki yo'lga bo'lindi.

def: Hali ona qornida o'sayotgan inson yoki hayvon.
ex: Some doctors say that what a mother eats has a big effect on her embryo.
exuz: Ba'zi shifokorlar ona yegan narsa homilasiga katta ta'sir qilishini aytadi.

def: Biror narsa voqealar qatorining oxirida sodir bo'lganda.
ex: We finally reached our destination.
exuz: Biz nihoyat manzilimizga yetib keldik.

def: Gazeta.
ex: Alice wants to write for a gazette when she's older.
exuz: Elis kattalashganda gazeta uchun yozmoqchi.

def: Biror narsa bir xil narsalardan iborat.
ex: All of the houses on Victor's block were boring and homogeneous.
exuz: Viktor yashaydigan kvartaldagi barcha uylar zerikarli va bir xil edi.

def: Guruhning bitta a'zosi.
ex: Each individual is responsible for themselves.
exuz: Har bir shaxs o'zi uchun javobgar.

def: Juda muhim voqea.
ex: There had been a major shift in government policy.
exuz: Hukumat siyosatida katta o'zgarish yuz bergan edi.

def: Biror narsaning yo'lini to'sish.
ex: The car broke down on the road and obstructed traffic for hours.
exuz: Mashina yo'lda buzilib qoldi va soatlab harakatga to'sqinlik qildi.

def: Juda tez pastga tushish.
ex: The water in the pool was very cold, but the boy plunged in anyway.
exuz: Basseyndagi suv juda sovuq edi, lekin bola baribir sho'ng'ib tushdi.

def: Biror narsani uzoqroq davom ettirish.
ex: Sandy walked slowly across the beach, trying to prolong her lunch break.
exuz: Sendi tushlik tanaffusini cho'zish uchun sohil bo'ylab sekin yurdi.

def: Biror narsaga katta e'tibor jalb qilish.
ex: The company publicized the job positions in the newspaper.
exuz: Kompaniya ish o'rinlarini gazetada e'lon qildi.

def: Biror narsaning qo'shimcha miqdori.
ex: The store sold their surplus items on sale.
exuz: Do'kon ortiqcha mollarini chegirma bilan sotdi.

def: Qiyin sharoitga qaramay yashashda davom etish.
ex: She survived a heart attack.
exuz: U yurak xurujidan omon qoldi.

def: Fikrlarni rivojlantirish.
ex: They enjoyed theorizing about how things worked.
exuz: Ular narsalar qanday ishlashi haqida nazariya qurishdan zavqlanardi.

def: Biror narsa rostligini bilib olish.
ex: Julian called the movie theater to verify that the movie started at nine.
exuz: Julian film soat to'qqizda boshlanishini tekshirish uchun kinoteatrga qo'ng'iroq qildi.

def: Odam yoki narsa ko'p energiya sarflasa.
ex: Henry uses vigorous exercise to keep himself in shape.
exuz: Genri o'zini formada saqlash uchun kuchli mashqlardan foydalanadi.

def: Cherkovlarda ishlatiladigan stol.
ex: The altar had many lit candles on it.
exuz: Qurbongohda ko'p yoqilgan sham bor edi.

def: Odamning bo'g'imlarida og'riq va shish keltirib chiqaradigan kasallik.
ex: Agatha couldn't play the piano anymore because of her arthritis.
exuz: Agata artriti tufayli endi pianino chala olmasdi.

def: O'simliklarni o'rganadigan fan.
ex: Gardens are the best places for botany.
exuz: Bog'lar botanika uchun eng yaxshi joy.

def: Biror narsa yoki kimgadir ishonish mumkin.
ex: Dick gave a credible reason for being late and didn't get in any trouble.
exuz: Dik kechikishi uchun ishonarli sabab keltirdi va hech qanday muammoga tushmadi.

def: Kimdir vafot etgan.
ex: We visited the graves of our deceased grandparents.
exuz: Biz vafot etgan bobo-buvilarimizning qabrini ziyorat qildik.

def: Yolg'on yoki hiyla bilan kimnidir aldash harakati.
ex: The magic looked very real, but it was only deception.
exuz: Sehr juda haqiqiydek ko'rindi, lekin bu faqat aldov edi.

def: Odatda kitob shaklida bo'lmagan yozma matn.
ex: Please scan this document so we have an electronic copy.
exuz: Iltimos, elektron nusxa bo'lishi uchun bu hujjatni skanerlang.

def: Hayvonlar ishlab chiqaradigan qattiq chiqindi.
ex: There was cow dung all over the field.
exuz: Butun dalada sigir go'ngi bor edi.

def: Kechqurun qorong'i bo'la boshlaydigan vaqt.
ex: After dusk, Hannah went to catch fireflies in the park.
exuz: Kech tushgach, Xanna parkda yorug'lik qurtlarini tutgani ketdi.

def: Kimnidir xursand qilish.
ex: Bonnie was gratified after receiving her gift from her parents.
exuz: Bonni ota-onasidan sovg'a olgach, xursand bo'ldi.

def: Biror narsani yaxshilab, juda yaxshi qilish.
ex: Lisa honed her chess skills through hours and hours of practice.
exuz: Liza soatlab mashq qilib, shaxmat mahoratini charxladi.

def: Biror narsaning ma'nosini topish, ko'pincha boshqa tilga o'tkazish.
ex: It is difficult to interpret while someone is speaking.
exuz: Kimdir gapirayotganda og'zaki tarjima qilish qiyin.

def: Biror ishni qilish sababingiz.
ex: We can show he had a motive to commit the crime, but we cannot show he did it.
exuz: Biz uning jinoyat sodir etish sababi borligini ko'rsata olamiz, lekin buni qilganini isbotlay olmaymiz.

def: O'pkani suyuqlik bilan to'ldiradigan xavfli kasallik.
ex: Elaine got pneumonia after playing outside in the rain without a coat.
exuz: Eleyn paltosiz yomg'irda o'ynagandan keyin zotiljam bo'ldi.

def: Odam nima bo'lishini yoki odamlar nima o'ylayotganini biladi.
ex: I think my grandmother has psychic abilities because she can predict anything.
exuz: Menimcha, buvimning folbinlik qobiliyati bor, chunki u hamma narsani bashorat qila oladi.
