def: Kimdir juda og'ir ruhiy kasallikka ega.
ex: The psychotic patient believed he saw things that weren't real.
exuz: Ruhiy kasal bemor haqiqiy bo'lmagan narsalarni ko'ryapman deb ishonardi.

def: Biror narsa qancha odam yoki narsaga tegishli ekani.
ex: Modern history has a wide scope.
exuz: Zamonaviy tarixning ko'lami keng.

def: Kimdir yoki nimadir yovuz.
ex: Bad guys in most movies have sinister laughs.
exuz: Ko'p filmlarda yomon qahramonlarning kulgisi yovuz bo'ladi.

def: Odamlar yoki guruhlar orasidagi kelishmovchilik yoki urush.
ex: There was a lot of strife between Jim and Lisa about what TV show to watch.
exuz: Jim va Liza o'rtasida qaysi ko'rsatuvni ko'rish haqida ko'p janjal bo'ldi.

def: Xabarlar almashishda ishlatiladigan til.
ex: Spoken text has many features which are different from written text.
exuz: Og'zaki matnning yozma matndan farq qiladigan ko'p xususiyati bor.

def: Yurakdan qon tananing qolgan qismiga olib boradigan naycha.
ex: Eating healthily keeps your arteries clean so blood can flow with ease.
exuz: Sog'lom ovqatlanish arteriyalaringizni toza saqlaydi va qon oson oqadi.

def: Biror narsa yomonlashishi harakati.
ex: The lack of care led to the deterioration of the house.
exuz: G'amxo'rlik yo'qligi uyning yomonlashuviga olib keldi.

def: Narsa yoki odamni topish qiyin.
ex: The elusive fish only came out at night.
exuz: Tutib bo'lmaydigan baliq faqat kechasi chiqardi.

def: Biror narsa bo'lishiga ishonch hosil qilish.
ex: Saving now will ensure we have enough money for our retirement.
exuz: Hozir pul yig'ish nafaqaga chiqqanimizda yetarli pul bo'lishini ta'minlaydi.

def: Biror narsani sodir qilish.
ex: Running without good shoes may induce leg pain.
exuz: Yaxshi poyabzalsiz yugurish oyoq og'rig'ini keltirib chiqarishi mumkin.

def: Ikki narsani ajratib bo'lmaydi.
ex: Denise and Diana have been inseparable since they first met.
exuz: Denis va Diana birinchi uchrashganidan beri ajralmas bo'lib qolgan.

def: Biror narsa to'g'ri bo'lmasa.
ex: The way to winning debates is to avoid invalid arguments.
exuz: Munozarada yutishning yo'li — noto'g'ri dalillardan qochish.

def: Biror narsani aslidan kattaroq ko'rsatish.
ex: Astronomers use telescopes to magnify faraway stars.
exuz: Astronomlar uzoq yulduzlarni kattalashtirish uchun teleskopdan foydalanadi.

def: Ko'pchilik normal deb hisoblab qabul qiladigan narsa.
ex: Before punk rock music became part of the mainstream, only a few people liked it.
exuz: Pank-rok musiqasi asosiy oqimga kirishidan oldin uni faqat bir necha kishi yoqtirardi.

def: Ko'pincha odamlarni kasal qiladigan juda kichik tirik mavjudot.
ex: The first step in curing a disease is finding the microbe that causes it.
exuz: Kasallikni davolashning birinchi qadami — uni keltirib chiqargan mikrobni topish.

def: Juda kichik va ahamiyatsiz muammo.
ex: This is a minor problem.
exuz: Bu arzimas muammo.

def: Biror narsa juda kichik va muhim bo'lmasa.
ex: The amount she owed was negligible. It was less than ten cents.
exuz: U qarzdor bo'lgan miqdor ahamiyatsiz edi. U o'n sentdan kam edi.

def: Tananing barchasi yoki bir qismini harakatlantirish qobiliyatini yo'qotish.
ex: His paralysis meant that he had to use a wheelchair to get around.
exuz: Uning falaji tufayli u harakatlanish uchun nogironlar aravachasidan foydalanishi kerak edi.

def: O'simlik yoki ovqatga zarar yetkazadigan hayvon yoki hasharot.
ex: Many farmers put up scarecrows to keep pests off their corn.
exuz: Ko'p fermer makkajo'xorisini zararkunandalardan saqlash uchun qo'rqitgich o'rnatadi.

def: Qabul qilingan yoki juda keng tarqalgan bo'lish.
ex: Unfortunately, injustice still prevails in the country's court system.
exuz: Afsuski, mamlakatning sud tizimida adolatsizlik hali ham hukmron.

def: Biror narsa ortidan quvayotganingizda.
ex: The pursuit of happiness is a basic human right.
exuz: Baxtga intilish — inson uchun asosiy huquq.

def: Yirtilish yoki ochilib ketish.
ex: Sarah put too much water into the balloon, and it ruptured.
exuz: Sara sharga juda ko'p suv quydi va u yorilib ketdi.

def: Odam yoki hayvon juda zo'ravon yoki shafqatsiz bo'lsa.
ex: Wild animals are very savage when defending their babies.
exuz: Yovvoyi hayvonlar bolalarini himoya qilganda juda shafqatsiz bo'ladi.

def: Kimnidir hayrat yoki shokdan gapira olmaydigan qilish.
ex: Tim fell off the swing and was too stunned to cry.
exuz: Tim belanchakdan yiqildi va dang qotib, yig'lay olmadi.

def: Kasallik kabi narsaga tez zarar ko'radi.
ex: Not eating enough vegetables makes you more susceptible to getting sick.
exuz: Sabzavotni yetarlicha yemaslik kasal bo'lishga moyilligingizni oshiradi.

def: Reja yoki g'oyani omma oldida qo'llab-quvvatlash.
ex: The group advocated increased spending on education and schools.
exuz: Guruh ta'lim va maktablarga xarajatni oshirishni qo'llab-quvvatladi.

def: «Garchi» ma'nosini bildiradi.
ex: She was happy, albeit briefly.
exuz: U xursand edi, garchi qisqa muddat bo'lsa ham.

def: Biror narsaga ruxsat berish.
ex: The mayor authorized the construction of a new statue in the park.
exuz: Hokim parkda yangi haykal qurilishiga ruxsat berdi.

def: Armiyada bo'lmagan odam.
ex: It was Todd's job to keep civilians from entering the army facility.
exuz: Todning ishi tinch aholini harbiy obyektga kiritmaslik edi.

def: Sotib olish yoki sotish mumkin bo'lgan narsa.
ex: Fran's uncle made most of his money trading commodities.
exuz: Franning amakisi pulining ko'p qismini tovar savdosidan topgan.

def: Boshqalar bilan gaplashish yoki yozish.
ex: He was unable to communicate his feelings clearly.
exuz: U his-tuyg'ularini aniq ifoda eta olmadi.

def: Bir mamlakat boshqasini egallab olishi.
ex: After the conquest, the people of the small city had no freedom.
exuz: Zabt etilgandan keyin kichik shahar odamlarida erkinlik qolmadi.

def: Biror narsani boshqa odamga aytib berish.
ex: John came home late, so he had to disclose his activities to his wife.
exuz: Jon uyga kech keldi, shuning uchun xotiniga qilgan ishlarini aytib berishi kerak edi.

def: Vaziyat qismlarining bir-biriga ta'sir qilish usuli.
ex: A good psychologist needs to know a lot about the dynamics of brain disorders.
exuz: Yaxshi psixolog miya buzilishlarining dinamikasi haqida ko'p bilishi kerak.

def: Guruh a'zosi sifatida o'z ismini ro'yxatga kiritish.
ex: The students had to enroll in the class one semester in advance.
exuz: O'quvchilar darsga bir semestr oldin yozilishi kerak edi.

def: Kimdir boshqada bor narsani xohlasa.
ex: They were envious of their neighbor's front yard.
exuz: Ular qo'shnisining oldingi hovlisiga havas qilishardi.

def: Biror narsa quvonchli va bayram bilan bog'liq.
ex: Dean's favorite part of Christmas is the festive clothing that people wear.
exuz: Dinning Rojdestvodagi sevimli qismi — odamlar kiyadigan bayramona kiyimlar.

def: Fikr yoki rejalarimizni ko'rsatish yoki ishora qilish.
ex: They indicated that things would be likely to improve soon.
exuz: Ular ishlar tez orada yaxshilanishi mumkinligini bildirishdi.

def: Odamlar pishirib yeydigan juda kichik loviya.
ex: Danni made her special soup with lentils when her husband was sick.
exuz: Denni eri kasal bo'lganda yasmiqli maxsus sho'rvasini tayyorladi.

def: Guruhni tartib bilan yig'ish.
ex: The students were marshaled outside and put into groups.
exuz: O'quvchilar tashqarida saflanib, guruhlarga bo'lindi.

def: Qiyin vaziyatda odamlarning umid darajasi.
ex: To improve our family's morale, mom suggested going on a picnic.
exuz: Oilamizning ruhiy holatini ko'tarish uchun onam pikinikka chiqishni taklif qildi.

def: Sizning his-tuyg'ularingiz.
ex: My boss is in a really bad mood today.
exuz: Boshlig'imning kayfiyati bugun juda yomon.

def: Kelajakda nima bo'lishi haqidagi oldindan aytilgan gap.
ex: Some people believe that prophecies are actually true.
exuz: Ba'zi odamlar bashoratlar haqiqatan ham rost bo'ladi deb ishonadi.

def: Ba'zi mamlakatlarda hukumatning bir qismi.
ex: Everybody liked Caroline and chose her to speak for them in the senate.
exuz: Hamma Karolinni yoqtirdi va uni senatda o'zlari nomidan so'zlash uchun tanladi.

def: Joydagi odamlar orasidagi g'azab holati.
ex: High taxes caused much of the unrest that led to the Revolutionary War.
exuz: Yuqori soliqlar inqilobiy urushga olib kelgan tartibsizlikning katta qismini keltirib chiqardi.

def: Biror narsaning natijalari to'g'ri ekanini tasdiqlash.
ex: The photograph on her passport certified that she was indeed Jolene Sawyer.
exuz: Pasportidagi surat uning haqiqatan Jolen Soyer ekanini tasdiqladi.

def: Rejaning qismlari bir-biriga yaxshi mos tushsa.
ex: This was a coherent program for solving the flooding problem.
exuz: Bu toshqin muammosini hal qilishning izchil dasturi edi.

def: Biror narsa ustida birga ishlash.
ex: When they collaborated, they managed to finish their chores early.
exuz: Birga ishlaganlarida ular uy ishlarini erta tugatishga muvaffaq bo'lishdi.

def: Turli narsalarni bir guruhga yig'ish.
ex: She compiled a list of people who she wanted to attend her birthday party.
exuz: U tug'ilgan kuniga kelishini istagan odamlar ro'yxatini tuzdi.

def: Biror narsaning sodir bo'lishi yoki ko'payishiga yo'l qo'ymaslik.
ex: She curbed her anger by listening to a relaxing song.
exuz: U tinchlantiruvchi qo'shiq tinglab g'azabini bosdi.

def: Kimningdir tibbiy holatini aniqlash.
ex: Several of the children were diagnosed with the flu.
exuz: Bir nechta bolaga gripp tashxisi qo'yildi.

def: Biror narsani qonunga aylantirish.
ex: The council enacted a law that would only allow buses to drive downtown.
exuz: Kengash shahar markazida faqat avtobuslar yurishiga ruxsat beradigan qonun qabul qildi.

def: Umumiy maqsad uchun ishlaydigan shtatlar yoki korxonalar guruhi.
ex: The United Nations is a federation designed to prevent war, disease, and famine.
exuz: Birlashgan Millatlar Tashkiloti urush, kasallik va ocharchilikning oldini olish uchun yaratilgan federatsiya.

def: Biror narsa jirkanch bo'lsa.
ex: The food was so gross that the dog couldn't eat it without feeling sick.
exuz: Ovqat shu qadar jirkanch ediki, it uni yeb, o'zini yomon his qilmay yeya olmadi.

def: Biror narsa yaxshi va mehribon bo'lsa.
ex: Helping build homes for poor people is very humane.
exuz: Kambag'allarga uy qurishga yordam berish juda insonparvarlik.

def: Kimdir juda kambag'al.
ex: After he lost his job, he became very needy.
exuz: Ishini yo'qotgandan keyin u juda muhtoj bo'lib qoldi.

def: Yoqimsiz narsaning boshlanishi.
ex: At the onset of the battle, the enemy wasn't prepared for such a large attack.
exuz: Jang boshlanishida dushman bunday katta hujumga tayyor emas edi.

def: Biror ish qilishga va'da berish.
ex: Her mother pledged that she would find her daughter's lost kitten.
exuz: Onasi qizining yo'qolgan mushukchasini topishga va'da berdi.

def: Biror narsaga ruxsat bermaslik.
ex: She prohibited the students from speaking until their work was done.
exuz: U o'quvchilarga ishlari tugamaguncha gapirishni taqiqladi.

def: Biror narsani boshqa narsaga aylantirish.
ex: His report was rendered unimportant by the release of new information.
exuz: Yangi ma'lumot e'lon qilingach, uning hisoboti ahamiyatsiz bo'lib qoldi.

def: Teridagi kichik do'ngliklar va yuqori isitma keltirib chiqaradigan kasallik.
ex: When she saw the tiny bumps, she thought her son might have smallpox.
exuz: Mayda do'ngliklarni ko'rib, u o'g'lida chechak bo'lishi mumkin deb o'yladi.

def: Biror narsani juda sezilarli tarzda o'zgartirish.
ex: The education system has been completely transformed.
exuz: Ta'lim tizimi butunlay o'zgartirildi.

def: Biror narsani bir odam yoki joydan boshqasiga o'tkazish.
ex: The radio tower transmits a signal to all the radios in a 20-kilometer radius.
exuz: Radio minorasi 20 kilometr radiusdagi barcha radiolarga signal uzatadi.

def: Biror ish qilishga va'da berish.
ex: Before they are allowed to work, all senators must vow to never accept bribes.
exuz: Ishlashga ruxsat berilishidan oldin barcha senatorlar hech qachon pora olmaslikka qasam ichishi kerak.

def: Butun dunyo bo'ylab keng tarqalgan narsa.
ex: It is a widespread belief that colds are caused by cold weather.
exuz: Shamollash sovuq havodan bo'ladi degan ishonch keng tarqalgan.

def: Qoida yoki kelishuv aytganidek harakat qilish.
ex: If the new employees wish to succeed, they must adhere to the boss's rules.
exuz: Yangi xodimlar muvaffaqiyat qozonmoqchi bo'lsa, boshliq qoidalariga rioya qilishi kerak.

def: Biror narsani tashkil qilish uchun mas'uliyatni o'z zimmasiga olish.
ex: The teacher's assistant will administer the test.
exuz: Ustozning yordamchisi testni o'tkazadi.

def: Odamlar boshqalarga achinadigan va hamdard bo'lsa.
ex: The compassionate nurse tried to make the sick man feel comfortable.
exuz: Rahmdil hamshira kasal erkakni qulay his qildirishga harakat qildi.

def: Biror narsaga iflos yoki zararli kimyoviy moddalar qo'shish.
ex: The lake was contaminated when pollutants entered the water.
exuz: Suvga ifloslantiruvchi moddalar kirganda ko'l ifloslandi.

def: Biror narsaning, ayniqsa zarur narsaning yetishmasligi.
ex: Your snack has a deficiency of any real nutrients.
exuz: Sizning gazagingizda haqiqiy oziq moddalar yetishmaydi.

def: Biror narsaga alohida e'tibor qaratish.
ex: The government placed a strong emphasis on educational reform.
exuz: Hukumat ta'lim islohotiga kuchli urg'u berdi.

def: Tez tarqaladigan kasallik avj olishi.
ex: It was difficult to stop the flu epidemic.
exuz: Gripp epidemiyasini to'xtatish qiyin edi.

def: Odamning salomatligi yoki xavfsizligiga xavfli bo'lishi mumkin narsa.
ex: Smoking cigarettes poses many health hazards.
exuz: Sigareta chekish sog'liqqa ko'p xavf tug'diradi.

def: Biror narsa juda muhim va albatta qilinishi kerak.
ex: It was imperative for him to find a job.
exuz: Uning uchun ish topish juda zarur edi.

def: Oziq oshqozondan chiqqandan keyin o'tadigan naychalar.
ex: Whatever you eat goes into your intestines.
exuz: Nima yesangiz, ichaklaringizga tushadi.

def: Biror narsani ko'rinadigan yoki aniq qilish.
ex: The joy of the holiday season manifested as bright smiles on the faces of the children.
exuz: Bayram faslining quvonchi bolalarning yuzida yorqin tabassum bo'lib namoyon bo'ldi.

def: Biror joyda juda ko'p odam yoki narsa bo'lsa.
ex: The lobby was overcrowded with people.
exuz: Dahliz odamlarga to'lib ketgan edi.

def: Shifokor.
ex: She made an appointment with the practitioner to treat her cough.
exuz: U yo'talini davolash uchun shifokor bilan uchrashuv belgiladi.

def: Muhtoj yoki xohlovchi odamlarga biror narsa berish.
ex: That department is responsible for the provision of emergency supplies.
exuz: O'sha bo'lim favqulodda zaxiralarni yetkazib berishga mas'ul.

def: Biror narsani yana to'la qilish.
ex: We planted nearly one hundred seeds to replenish the garden after the fire.
exuz: Yong'indan keyin bog'ni qayta to'ldirish uchun yuzga yaqin urug' ekdik.

def: Mashina orqaga yursa.
ex: We reversed out of the parking place and then drove away.
exuz: Biz to'xtash joyidan orqaga chiqib, keyin haydab ketdik.

def: Biror narsa butunlay toza va mikroblardan xoli.
ex: The hospital room looked quite sterile.
exuz: Kasalxona xonasi ancha steril ko'rinardi.

def: Biror narsani yaxshilash yoki samaraliroq qilish.
ex: He upgraded to a real fancy car.
exuz: U haqiqiy hashamatli mashinaga almashtirdi.

def: Biror narsa mo'ljallangan ishni qila olsa.
ex: Her method of solving the math problem seemed viable.
exuz: Uning matematika masalasini yechish usuli yaroqli ko'rindi.

def: Biror narsa tanlov bilan qilinadi, lekin majburiy emas.
ex: Many people attended the voluntary boat safety class.
exuz: Ko'p odam qayiq xavfsizligi bo'yicha ixtiyoriy darsga qatnashdi.

def: Havo odamning o'pkasiga yetadigan yo'l.
ex: Since he was sick, mucus would occasionally get stuck in his airway.
exuz: U kasal bo'lgani uchun ba'zan balg'am nafas yo'lida tiqilib qolardi.

def: Dindagi xudoning nomi.
ex: Before eating, they thanked the Almighty for their food.
exuz: Ovqatlanishdan oldin ular ovqat uchun Qodir Egaga shukr aytishdi.

def: Muhim odam, narsa yoki voqeaning kelishi yoki boshlanishi.
ex: During the advent of radio, very few programs actually played music.
exuz: Radio paydo bo'lgan davrda juda kam ko'rsatuv musiqa qo'ygan.

def: Oxiridan yana boshiga qaytadigan voqealar qatori.
ex: They were caught in a cycle of poverty, lack of education, and unemployment.
exuz: Ular qashshoqlik, ta'limsizlik va ishsizlik doirasida qolib ketishgan edi.

def: Biror narsa eng rasmiy bo'lsa.
ex: This library has the definitive collection of books on ancient Egypt.
exuz: Bu kutubxonada qadimgi Misr haqidagi eng to'liq kitoblar to'plami bor.

def: Bir narsani boshqasi bilan solishtirib, juda o'xshash deb hisoblash.
ex: She equated the man's messy appearance with a lack of responsibility.
exuz: U erkakning tartibsiz ko'rinishini mas'uliyatsizlik bilan tenglashtirdi.

def: G'oya yoki tamoyil asosida biror narsa qurish.
ex: This is founded on the belief that all people are created equal.
exuz: Bu hamma odam teng yaratilgan degan ishonchga asoslangan.

def: E'tiqodlar tizimi.
ex: Within the teachers' ideology, there was a belief in the value of parent participation.
exuz: Ustozlar mafkurasida ota-onalar ishtirokining qadriga ishonch bor edi.

def: Havo yoki hidni o'pkaga tortish.
ex: The camper inhaled the cool and fresh mountain air and felt relaxed.
exuz: Sayyoh salqin, toza tog' havosini ichiga tortib, o'zini xotirjam his qildi.

def: Dalil keltirish yoki yordam so'rash uchun biror narsani tilga olish.
ex: Before going into battle, the soldier invoked the name of his god for protection.
exuz: Jangga kirishdan oldin askar himoya uchun xudosining nomini chaqirdi.

def: Biror narsa oyga aloqador.
ex: During a lunar eclipse, Earth's shadow darkens the moon's surface.
exuz: Oy tutilishi paytida Yer soyasi oy yuzasini qoraytiradi.

def: Yangi, original yoki g'alati narsa.
ex: Ice cream was a novelty for him since he rarely had any.
exuz: Muzqaymoq u uchun yangilik edi, chunki u kamdan-kam yer edi.

def: Biror narsa endi modada yoki ishlatilmaydi.
ex: Black and white television sets are outmoded.
exuz: Oq-qora televizorlar eskirgan.

def: Biror narsani odamning o'ziga xos ehtiyojlariga moslab yaratish.
ex: He personalized the woman's exercises to give her a better workout.
exuz: U ayolga yaxshiroq mashq bo'lishi uchun mashqlarni o'ziga moslab berdi.

def: Ruhiy kasallik yoki uni davolashga oid.
ex: The doctor said the patient might have a psychiatric problem.
exuz: Shifokor bemorda psixiatrik muammo bo'lishi mumkinligini aytdi.

def: Ruhiy kasalliklarni o'rganish va davolash.
ex: Studying psychiatry has taught me a lot about mental illness.
exuz: Psixiatriyani o'rganish menga ruhiy kasalliklar haqida ko'p narsa o'rgatdi.

def: Tana qismi voqeaga beixtiyor javob qaytarishi.
ex: There was a reflex when the doctor hit his knee with a rubber hammer.
exuz: Shifokor tizzasiga rezina bolg'a bilan urganida refleks bo'ldi.

def: Tana to'satdan nazoratni yo'qotib, titraydigan holat.
ex: Bright flashing lights can cause seizures in children.
exuz: Yorqin miltillovchi chiroqlar bolalarda tutqanoq xurujini keltirib chiqarishi mumkin.

def: Muammoni muhokama qilib hal qilish uchun muntazam vaqtdagi uchrashuv.
ex: Every three months, the managers met in a session to discuss regional sales.
exuz: Har uch oyda menejerlar mintaqaviy savdoni muhokama qilish uchun majlisga yig'ilishardi.

def: Keng tarqalgan asbob yoki idish.
ex: It seemed that a fork was the wrong utensil for trying to eat the soup.
exuz: Sho'rva ichish uchun vilka noto'g'ri asbob bo'lib tuyuldi.

def: Biror narsani ma'lum maqsad yoki odam uchun chetga qo'yish.
ex: The government allocated $100 million to aid the disaster relief effort.
exuz: Hukumat ofat oqibatlarini bartaraf etishga yordam berish uchun 100 million dollar ajratdi.

def: Ovqat juda yaxshi ko'rinadi va hidlanadi.
ex: The appetizing plate of cookies was gone in half an hour.
exuz: Ishtaha ochuvchi pechenye likopchasi yarim soatda tugadi.

def: Odamlarga muayyan ishni berish.
ex: I was assigned the job of making sure everyone had plenty to drink.
exuz: Menga hammaga ichimlik yetarli bo'lishini nazorat qilish vazifasi topshirildi.

def: Biror narsadagi teshik yoki bo'sh joy.
ex: There was a small cavity in the wall of the cave, where an animal lived.
exuz: G'or devorida hayvon yashaydigan kichik kovak bor edi.

def: Biror narsa soat kabi bir yo'nalishda aylana bo'ylab harakat qilsa.
ex: Turn the screw clockwise to tighten it.
exuz: Murvatni mahkamlash uchun uni soat strelkasi bo'yicha buring.

def: Doiralar yoki halqalar bir xil markazga ega.
ex: The target was a series of concentric circles.
exuz: Nishon bir markazli doiralar qatoridan iborat edi.

def: Odob-axloq yoki ijtimoiy xulqning a'loligi.
ex: Jenna always behaves with great courtesy when people visit her home.
exuz: Jenna uyiga odam kelganda doim katta xushmuomalalik bilan o'zini tutadi.

def: Ovqat qattiq yoki yoqimli qattiq sirtga ega.
ex: My favorite snack is a bag of crisp, delicious potato chips.
exuz: Mening sevimli gazagim — bir paket xrustillagan, mazali kartoshka chipsi.

def: Kelishmovchilik yoki urush.
ex: There was much discord between the experts on the talk show.
exuz: Teleko'rsatuvdagi mutaxassislar o'rtasida katta kelishmovchilik bor edi.

def: Biror narsaning rivojlanishi yoki boshlanishiga sabab bo'lish.
ex: The mayor promised to generate new jobs and programs to help the poor.
exuz: Hokim kambag'allarga yordam berish uchun yangi ish o'rinlari va dasturlar yaratishga va'da berdi.

def: Bitta alohida narsa.
ex: There were some items of clothing found at the crime scene.
exuz: Jinoyat sodir bo'lgan joydan bir necha kiyim buyumi topildi.

def: Odamlar o'rtasidagi har birining fikrini muhokama qilish.
ex: There was an interchange of ideas between the groups.
exuz: Guruhlar o'rtasida g'oyalar almashinuvi bo'ldi.

def: Biror narsa ko'p turli madaniyatga oid.
ex: Everyone was welcome to attend the multicultural celebration.
exuz: Ko'p madaniyatli bayramga hamma xush kelibsiz edi.

def: Qoldirilgan yoki qilinmagan narsa.
ex: Mike was upset because of the omission of his name during the ceremony.
exuz: Marosim paytida ismi tushirib qoldirilgani uchun Mayk xafa bo'ldi.

def: Biror narsa to'g'ri bajarilayotganiga ishonch hosil qilish.
ex: His job was to oversee the progress of the construction project.
exuz: Uning ishi qurilish loyihasining borishini nazorat qilish edi.

def: O'tkir narsa bilan teshik ochish.
ex: The arrow pierced the target in the very center.
exuz: O'q nishonni aynan markazidan teshdi.

def: Biror narsani ehtiyotkorlik bilan tanlash.
ex: They had to select textbooks for each class.
exuz: Ular har bir sinf uchun darsliklarni tanlashlari kerak edi.

def: Bino yoki guruh qismlarining shakli va tashkil etilishi.
ex: There are big differences in family structure in different cultures.
exuz: Turli madaniyatlarda oila tuzilishida katta farqlar bor.

def: Ko'rishga oid.
ex: The visual displays were very attractive.
exuz: Ko'rgazmali namoyishlar juda jozibali edi.

def: Biror narsa to'g'ri emas, egri chiziqlardan iborat.
ex: The child drew wavy lines all over the piece of paper.
exuz: Bola qog'oz bo'ylab to'lqinsimon chiziqlar chizdi.

def: Biror narsani boshqa holat yoki shaklga o'zgartirish.
ex: The city discussed the conversion of the parking lot into a skateboard park.
exuz: Shahar to'xtash joyini skeyt-parkka aylantirish haqida muhokama qildi.

def: Narsalarni zo'rg'a sig'adigan joyga solish.
ex: He crammed all of his shirts into the top drawer of the dresser.
exuz: U barcha ko'ylaklarini shkafchaning yuqori tortmasiga tiqib tashladi.

def: Biror ishni keyinroq qilishni rejalashtirish.
ex: The girl was very sleepy, so she chose to defer her bath until morning.
exuz: Qiz juda uyqusirardi, shuning uchun cho'milishni ertalabga qoldirdi.

def: Mahsulotlarni boshqa mamlakatlarga sotish.
ex: The United States exports many cereals and grains.
exuz: AQSh ko'p don mahsulotlarini eksport qiladi.

def: Olov yoki kimyoviy moddalardan chiqadigan sog'liq uchun zararli tutun va gazlar.
ex: The engine put unpleasant, black fumes into the air.
exuz: Dvigatel havoga yoqimsiz, qora tutun chiqardi.

def: Odam odatda qiladigan yoki ega bo'lgan xulq-atvor.
ex: The man was a habitual liar who was incapable of being honest with anyone.
exuz: Erkak odatiy yolg'onchi edi va hech kim bilan halol bo'la olmasdi.

def: Biror narsa zarur ekanini ko'rsatish yoki isbotlash.
ex: The government tried to justify its decision to bring the country into a war.
exuz: Hukumat mamlakatni urushga olib kirish qarorini oqlashga urindi.

def: Biror narsa qilingan bo'lsa ham yetarli emasligini ko'rsatadi.
ex: Notwithstanding your objections, we have decided to move forward with the project.
exuz: E'tirozlaringizga qaramay, biz loyihani davom ettirishga qaror qildik.

def: Odam yoki narsa ishlab chiqaradigan miqdor.
ex: The boss hired more workers to increase the factory's output of products.
exuz: Boshliq zavodning mahsulot ishlab chiqarishini oshirish uchun ko'proq ishchi yolladi.

def: Joyda juda ko'p odam bo'lishi holati.
ex: The organization is concerned with the overpopulation of the world.
exuz: Tashkilot dunyo aholisining haddan ziyod ko'payishidan xavotirda.

def: Yangi mahsulotni yasash yoki sotish uchun yagona huquq.
ex: He quickly established a patent for his brilliant invention.
exuz: U ajoyib ixtirosi uchun tezda patent oldi.

def: Kimnidir jazolash.
ex: The team was penalized when they broke the rules.
exuz: Jamoa qoidalarni buzganda jazolandi.

def: Ko'p yoqilg'i olinadigan suyuq tabiiy resurs.
ex: The petroleum at that factory is used to make gasoline.
exuz: O'sha zavoddagi neft benzin tayyorlash uchun ishlatiladi.

def: Odatda umumiy xususiyatga asoslangan katta yer maydoni.
ex: This is the wheat-growing region of the country.
exuz: Bu mamlakatning bug'doy yetishtiriladigan hududi.

def: Biror narsaning kichik miqdori.
ex: Chris liked to use many scraps of paper when thinking up ideas.
exuz: Kris g'oya o'ylayotganda ko'p qog'oz parchalaridan foydalanishni yoqtirardi.

def: Mamlakat iqtisodiyotining muayyan sanoat turidagi qismi.
ex: We learned about just a few of the factories within the manufacturing sector.
exuz: Biz ishlab chiqarish tarmog'idagi faqat bir necha zavod haqida o'rgandik.

def: Biror narsaga rozi bo'lish.
ex: She subscribed to the view that musical education should be kept in schools.
exuz: U musiqiy ta'lim maktablarda saqlanib qolishi kerak degan fikrga qo'shildi.

def: Tirik qolish uchun kerakli ovqat, suv va pulga ega bo'lish.
ex: Some people are forced to subsist on only a few dollars a month.
exuz: Ba'zi odamlar oyiga bir necha dollarga zo'rg'a yashashga majbur.

def: Biror narsani qisqa muddatga kechiktirish yoki to'xtatish.
ex: The oil company suspended production until it was sure the factory was safe.
exuz: Neft kompaniyasi zavod xavfsizligiga ishonch hosil qilmaguncha ishlab chiqarishni to'xtatdi.

def: Turli g'oya yoki uslublar uyg'unligi.
ex: The band's music was a synthesis of many different musical genres.
exuz: Guruhning musiqasi ko'p turli janrlarning uyg'unligi edi.

def: Ajoyib jismoniy ishlar qilib odamlarni xursand qiladigan kishi.
ex: There were acrobats at the circus that did impressive and complicated jumps.
exuz: Sirkda ta'sirli va murakkab sakrashlar qiladigan akrobatlar bor edi.

def: Biror narsani qo'llab-quvvatlash yoki tavsiya qilish.
ex: Janine's strong advocacy for the event made people want to attend.
exuz: Janinning tadbirni qattiq qo'llab-quvvatlashi odamlarni qatnashishga undadi.

def: Biror narsa odamlar guruhiga tegishli.
ex: On the weekends, Theo and his son picked up trash in the communal park.
exuz: Dam olish kunlari Teo va uning o'g'li umumiy parkdagi axlatni terishdi.

def: Biror narsa silliq va nafis harakatlanadi.
ex: Boris was a famous ballet dancer because people admired his fluid movements.
exuz: Boris mashhur balet raqqosi edi, chunki odamlar uning silliq harakatlariga qoyil qolishardi.

def: Turli narsalarni bir-biriga mos qilish.
ex: The sweet and sour flavors of the dish harmonized well and tasted great.
exuz: Taomning shirin va nordon ta'mlari yaxshi uyg'unlashdi va mazali bo'ldi.

def: Odam qattiq ishlasa.
ex: Dennis was very industrious, so he never had problems finding a job.
exuz: Dennis juda mehnatsevar edi, shuning uchun ish topishda hech qachon qiyinchilik ko'rmadi.

def: Kimdir yangi narsalar yaratishda mohir.
ex: The inventive student built a robot to help him with her chores.
exuz: Zukko o'quvchi uy ishlarida yordam beradigan robot yasadi.

def: Xitoyning ikkita asosiy tilidan biri.
ex: Although John's parents both spoke Mandarin, he could only speak English.
exuz: Jonning ota-onasi ikkalasi ham mandarin tilida gapirsa-da, u faqat inglizcha gapira olardi.

def: Biror narsa katta shaharga aloqador.
ex: After years of living on a farm, Rufu was finally moving to a metropolitan area.
exuz: Fermada yillar yashagach, Rufu nihoyat yirik shahar hududiga ko'chib o'tdi.

def: Biror narsaning tovushi, harakati, ko'rinishiga o'xshatib qilish.
ex: The hunter mimicked a duck's call and shot the two ducks that called back.
exuz: Ovchi o'rdakning ovoziga taqlid qilib, javob bergan ikkita o'rdakni otdi.

def: Biror narsa yomon hukm yoki noto'g'ri e'tiqodga asoslangan.
ex: The snake bit Molly during her misguided attempt to catch it.
exuz: Molli ilonni tutishga noto'g'ri urinayotganda ilon uni chaqdi.

def: Odamlar oldida chiqishga mashq qilib tayyorlanish.
ex: Vick's band rehearsed all week before their first show.
exuz: Vikning guruhi birinchi shou oldidan butun hafta mashq qildi.

def: Odam o'zidagi vositalardan foydalanishda zukko.
ex: Because he was very resourceful, he could make most of the things he needed rather than buying them.
exuz: U juda topqir bo'lgani uchun kerakli narsalarning ko'pini sotib olmay o'zi yasay olardi.

def: Kimgadir hurmatsizlik bilan munosabatda bo'lish.
ex: The criminal was scorned by everyone in the community.
exuz: Jinoyatchini jamoadagi hamma mensimasdi.

def: Biror narsa his qilishga aloqador.
ex: Iris and Eric preferred the sensory thrill of watching movies in the theater.
exuz: Iris va Erik kinoteatrda film ko'rishning sezgi hayajonini afzal ko'rishardi.

def: Rasmiy va yozib qo'yilgan qonun.
ex: The new statute made it illegal to walk dogs in the park.
exuz: Yangi qonun parkda it sayr qildirishni noqonuniy qildi.

def: Texnik mahorat uslubni yaxshi nazorat qilishni talab qiladi.
ex: Her technical skill was perfect.
exuz: Uning texnik mahorati mukammal edi.

def: Biror ishni qilishda katta tajribaga ega odam.
ex: Hank was the team veteran and had completed more races than anyone else.
exuz: Henk jamoaning tajribali a'zosi edi va hammadan ko'p poygani tugatgan edi.

def: Qonunni buzadigan yoki boshqalarga zarar yetkazadigan yovuz odam.
ex: The villain made off with half of my family's valuables.
exuz: Yovuz odam oilamning qimmatbaho buyumlarining yarmini olib qochdi.

def: Uzun, o'rilgan poyali va yuqoriga chiqadigan o'simlik.
ex: The branches of the trees were covered with vines.
exuz: Daraxt shoxlari chirmashgan o'simlik bilan qoplangan edi.
